a: Middeitzterich leh lehillel letakkone netina beal korcho havya netina, ha bealma netina beal korcho la havya netina.
Matkef la rav pappa, veittema rav ashe: vedilma ki itztericha leh lehillel letakkone shello befanav, aval befanav — ben middato ben beal korcho havya mattana!

Ikka deamri, amar rava: mittakkanato shel hillel — "hare ze gittich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz", unetanah lo, ben middato ben beal korcho — havya netina. vechi itzterich leh lehillel letakkone — shello befanav, aval befanav — ben middato ben beal korcho havya netina.
Matkef la rav pappa, veittema rav shimi bar ashe: vedilma ben befanav ben shello befanav, middato — in, beal korcho — la, vehillel may deitzterich leh takken!

Mishna kol shehu lifnim min hachoma — hare hu kevatte are choma, chutz min hassadot. rabbi meir omer: af hassadot. bayit habbanuy bachoma — rabbi yehuda omer: eno kevatte are choma. rabbi shimon omer: kotel hachitzon hi chomato.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: bayit — en li ella bayit, minnayin lerabbot batte vaddim uvatte merchatzaot umigdalot veshovachin uvorot veshichin umearot? talmud lomar: "asher bair". yachol sheani merabbe af hassadot? talmud lomar: "bayit", divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi meir omer: neemar "bayit" — en li ella bayit, minnayin lerabbot batte vaddim uvatte merchatzaot, umigdalot veshovachin, uvorot shichin umearot, vaafillu sadot? talmud lomar: "asher bair".
Veella ha ketiv "bayit"! amar rav chisda amar rav kattina: cholsit umetzula ikka benayyhu, vehatanya: cholsit umetzula, rabbi meir omer: kevattim, rabbi yehuda omer: kesadot.

Bayit habbanuy bachoma, rabbi yehuda omer: eno kevatte are choma. amar rabbi yochanan: ushenehem mikra echad darshu, "vattoridem bachevel bead hachallon ki vetah bekir hachoma uvachoma hi yoshavet". rabbi shimon savar kifshateh dikra, verabbi yehuda savar: "bachoma hi yoshavet" velo beir choma.

Mishna ir sheggaggoteha chomatah, vesheenah mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, enah kevatte are choma. veellu hen batte are choma: shalosh chatzerot shel shene vattim, mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, kegon katzra hayyeshana shel tzippori, vechakra shel gush chalav, veyodfat hayyeshana, vegamla, ugedod, vechadid, veono, virushalayim, vechen keyotze bahen.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "choma" — velo shur iggar, "saviv" — perat litverya sheyyammah chomatah.
Rabbi eliezer bar yose omer: "asher lo choma" — af al pi sheen lo achshav vehaya lo kodem lachen.
Veellu hen batte are choma kulei. tana: gamla baggalil, ugedod beever hayyarden, vechadid veono virushalayim bihuda. may kaamar?
b: Amar abbaye: hachi kaamar — ad gamla baggalil, ad gedod beever hayyarden, vechadid veono virushalayim bihuda.
Rava amar: gamla baggalil, leappoke gamla dishar aratzot; gedod beever hayyarden, leappoke gedod dishar aratzot; inach dela ikka dichvatayyhu — la itzterich leh.
Virushalayim mi michalat ba? vehatanya: asara devarim neemru birushalayim, en habbayit chalut bah!

Amar rabbi yochanan: kirushalayim demukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, velo kirushalayim, deillu yerushalayim en habbayit chalut bah, veillu hacha habbayit chalut (bahen) [bah]. rav ashe amar: lav amar rav yosef tere kadesh havo? hacha name tere yerushalayim havo.

Tanya, rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: lamma manu chachamim et ellu, shekkeshealu bene haggola matzu ellu vekiddeshum, aval rishonot batlu mishshebbatla kedushshat haaretz. kasavar: kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah, velo kiddesha leatid lavo.

Ureminhi: amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: vechi ellu bilvad hayu? vahalo kevar neemar: "shishshim ir kol chevel argov... kol elle arim betzurot"! ella lamma manu chachamim et ellu? shekkeshealu bene haggola matzu ellu vekiddeshum. kiddeshum? ha amrinan dela tzerich lekaddoshinhu! ella menaum.

Velo ellu bilvad, ella kol shettaale lecha masoret beyadcha meavotecha shemmukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun — kol mitzvot hallalu nohagot bah, mippene shekkedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo!

Ibbaet ema: tere tannae veallibba derabbi yishmael, veibbaet ema: chad minnayyhu rabbi elazar bar yose amra, detanya: rabbi elazar bar yose omer: "asher lo choma" — af al pi sheen lo achshav vehaya lo kodem lachen.

May tama deman deamar: kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo? dichtiv: "vayyaasu bene haggola hashshavim min hashshevi sukkot vayyeshvu vassukkot ki lo asu mime yeshua bin nun ken bene yisrael vegomer vattehi simcha gedola meod". efshar ba david velo asu sukkot ad shebba ezra?
Ella makkish biatam bime ezra leviatam bime yehoshua, ma biatam bime yehoshua manu shemittin veyovlot vekiddeshu are choma, af biatan bime ezra manu shemittin veyovlot vekiddeshu are choma.

Veomer: "veheviacha Adonai elohecha el haaretz asher yarshu avotecha virishtah", makkish yerushshatcha lirushshat avotecha — ma yerushshat avotecha bechiddush kol devarim hallalu, af yerushshatcha bechiddush kol devarim hallalu.
Veiddach? divo rachame al yetzer daavoda zara, uvatteleh, veaggen zechuta alayyhu ki sukka.

Vehayeynu deka kafed kera illaveh dihoshua, divchol ducheta ketiv "yehoshua", vehacha ketiv "yeshua". bishlama moshe la bea rachame, dela hava zechuta deeretz yisrael, ella yehoshua dahava leh zechuta deeretz yisrael, ammay la live rachame?
Veha chetiv: "asher yarshu avotecha virishtah"! hachi kaamar: kevan deyarshu avotecha — yarashta at.

Umi manu shemittin veyovlot? hasheta mishsheggalu shevet reuven veshevet gad vachatzi shevet menashshe batlu yovlot, ezra dichtiv beh "kol hakkahal keechad arba ribbo alpayim veshesh meot veshishshim" hava mane?

Detanya: mishsheggalu shevet reuven veshevet gad vachatzi shevet hamenashshe batlu yovlot, shenneemar: "ukeratem deror baaretz lechol yoshveha", bizman shekkol yoshveha aleha, velo bizman sheggalu miktzatan.
Yachol hayu aleha vehen meoravin, shevet binyamin bihuda veshevet yehuda bevinyamin, yehe yovel noheg? talmud lomar: "lechol yoshveha" — bizman sheyyoshveha ketikkunan, velo bizman shehen meoravin!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: manu yovlot lekaddesh shemittin.

a: Hanicha lerabbanan deamri: shenat chamishshim enah min hamminyan, ella lerabbi yehuda deamar: shenat chamishshim ola lechan ulechan, lema li? bishmittin saggi! ha vadday dela kerabbi yehuda.
Velo manu shemittin veyovlot? vehachtiv: "mikketz sheva shanim teshallechu ish et achiv haivri asher yimmacher lecha"!
Vehavenan behu: "mikketz sheva shanim"? vehachtiv: "vaavadcha shesh shanim"! veamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: shesh lannimkar, vesheva lannirtza.
Hahu betochacha ketiv, vekaamar navi: hashillachtem? vehachtiv: "vayyishmeu vayshallechu"!

Ella amar rabbi yochanan: yirmeya hechziran, veyoshiyya ben amon malach alehen. umena lan dahadur? dichtiv: "ki hammocher el hammimkar lo yashuv". efshar yovel batel, venavi mitnabbe alav sheyyivtal? ella melammed shehechziran yirmeya.

Umenalan deyoshiyya malach alehen? dichtiv: "vayyomer ma hatztziyyun hallaz asher ani roe, vayyomru elav anshe hair hakkever ish haelohim asher ba mihuda vayyikra et haddevarim al hammizbeach bet el".
Vechi ma tivo shel yoshiyyahu bevet el? ella keshehechziran yirmeyahu, yoshiyyahu malach alehem. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha: "gam yehuda shat katzir lach beshuvi shevut ammi".
Mishna batte hachatzerim notnin lahem koach yafe shebbevatte are choma vechoach yafe shebbassadot, venigalin miyyad vechol shenem asar chodesh kevattim, veyotzin bayyovel uvegiron kesef kesadot.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "al sede haaretz yechashev" — hikkisho hakkatuv lisde achuzza, ma sede achuzza yotze bayyovel uvegiron kesef, af batte hachatzerim yotzin bayyovel uvegiron kesef.

I ma sede achuzza enah nigelet befachot mishte shanim, af batte hachatzerim enam nigalim pachot mishte shanim? talmud lomar: "geulla tihye lo" — miyyad. hoil venatatta lahem koach yafe shebbassadot vechoach yafe shebbabbattim, yachol lo yetzu bayyovel? talmud lomar: "uvayyovel yetze".
May kaamar? amar rav huna: lo nitzrecha ella lemakdish bayit bevatte hachatzerim, ugealo acher miyyad hekdesh, ufaga bo yovel beshana sheniyya.
Lemay medammet leh? i levatte are choma medammet leh — ichalet leh lelokeach, i lisde achuzza medammet — lechohanim nafka, lehachi itzterich "uveyovel yetze".
Matkef la rav zeera: may irya gealo acher? afillu lo gealo name! amar leh abbaye: shello yomru hekdesh yotze belo pidyon.
Menalan? mibben levi — ma ben levi sheyyippa kocho bemimkaro, hora kocho behekdesho; yisrael — shehora kocho bemimkaro, en din shehora kocho behekdesho?
Vehatam menalan? detanya: "veyatza mimkar", shomea ani afillu avadav mittaltelav ushetarav, talmud lomar: "bayit veir achuzzato".
Ma talmud lomar "mimkar"? mimkaroyo yotze bechinnam, veen hekdesh yotze bechinnam, ella befidyon.
Ufeliga derabbi oshaya, deamar rabbi oshaya: hakkol hayu bichlal "venatan hakkesef vekam lo".
Keshepparat hakkatuv bisde achuzza "vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel kodesh laAdonai" — sade hu difrak leh venafka lechohanim, aval hanach kidkayymi kayymi.
"Uvayyovel yetze", lema li? amar rav pappa: lo nitzrecha ella lemocher bayit bevatte hachatzerim, ufaga bo yovel beshana sheniyya.
Lemay medammet leh? i levatte are choma medammet leh — ichalet leh lelokeach, i lisde achuzza medammet leh — hashelama bae, lehachi itzterich "uvayyovel yetze".

Tanya kevavteh derav huna, uteyuveta derabbi oshaya: hammakdish bayit bevatte hachatzerim — hare ze goel miyyad vegoalo leolam; gealo acher miyyad hekdesh, higgia yovel velo nigal — chozer labbealim bayyovel.
b: Mishna veellu hen batte hachatzerim — shene chatzerim shel shene vattim, af al pi shemmukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, hare hen kevatte chatzerim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: mimmashma shenneemar "batte hachatzerim" eni yodea sheen lahem choma? ma talmud lomar "asher en lahem choma"? af al pi sheyyesh lahem choma kemi sheen lahem choma. vechamma? battim — shenayim, chatzerot — shenayim, shete chatzerot shel shene vattim.
Veema bayit vechatzer! im ken lichtov rachamana "chatzerim", vechi tema i ketav rachamana "chatzerim" — chatzer belo bayit mashma, hahu karpef ikkeri.
Mishna yisrael sheyyarash avi immo levi — eno goel kasseder hazze. vechen levi sheyyarash et avi immo yisrael — eno goel kasseder hazze.
Shenneemar: "ki vatte are haleviyyim hiv achuzzatam", ad sheyyehe levi veare haleviyyim, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: en devarim hallalu amurim ella beare haleviyyim.
Gemara veella keman? keven levi. vahadar tane: "ad sheyyehe levi veare haleviyyim".
Ema: eno goel ella kasseder hazze, ad sheyyehe levi veare haleviyyim, divre rabbi.
Bishlama are haleviyyim — dichtiv: "ki batte are haleviyyim", ella levi menalan? dichtiv: "vaasher yigal min haleviyyim".
Tanya: "vaasher yigal min haleviyyim" — yachol levi miyyisrael yigal, shezze yippa kocho veze hora kocho, aval levi millevi lo, shezze yippa kocho veze yippa kocho — talmud lomar: "min haleviyyim".
"Min haleviyyim" — velo kol haleviyyim, perat leven levi mamzer venatin.
Vachachamim omrim: en devarim hallalu amurim ella beare haleviyyim. aval ad sheyyehe levi — la amrinan.
Mishna en osin sade migrash, velo migrash sade, velo migrash ir, velo ir migrash.

Amar rabbi elazar: bamme devarim amurim? beare haleviyyim, aval beare yisrael osin sade migrash, velo migrash sade, migrash ir, velo ir migrash, shello yachrivu et are yisrael. hakkohanim vehaleviyyim mochrin leolam, vegoalin leolam, shenneemar: "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim".
Gemara amar rabbi elazar: "bamme devarim amurim? beare haleviyyim, aval beare yisrael osin" vechulei. dechulle alma miha bedilviyyim la meshannenan, mena hane mille?

Amar rabbi elazar, deamar kera: "usede migrash arehem lo yimmacher". may "lo yimmacher"? illema lo yimmacher kelal, veha middichtiv: "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim", mikkelal dimzabbeni. ella may "lo yimmacher"? lo yeshanne.

Hakkohanim vehaleviyyim mochrin leolam vegoalin leolam. tanu rabbanan: "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim", ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar: "bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach", yachol af ze ken? talmud lomar: "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim".
Lefi shenneemar: "vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel kodesh laAdonai", yachol af ze ken? talmud lomar: "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim".
Lefi shenneemar: "vekam habbayit asher bair asher lo choma latztzemitut", yachol af ze ken? talmud lomar: "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim".
Bishlama hane tarte lechayye, ella batte are choma lilviyyim mi it lehu? vehatanya: arim hallalu en osin otan lo kefarim ketannim velo kerakkim gedolim, ella ayayrot benoniyyot!
Amar rav kahana: la kashya, kan — shehukkaf ulevassof yashav, kan — sheyyashav ulevassof hukkaf.
Vechi hay gavvna mi havya choma? vehatanya: "veish ki yimkor bet moshav ir choma" — shehukkaf ulevassof yashav, velo sheyyashav ulevassof hukkaf.
Yachol afillu hikkifuha yisrael? neemar kan "choma", veneemar lehallan "choma", ma lehallan goyim, af kan goyim.
Yachol afillu hikkifuha goyim leachar mikken? neemar lehallan "choma", veneemar kan "choma", ma lehallan goyim kodem lachen, af kan goyim kodem lachen!
Targema rav yosef bereh derav salla chasida kammeh derav pappa, kegon shennaflu lahen

a: Hen umigreshehen, hen umigreshehen lemisterinhu kayymi. amar rav ashe: itzterich, salka datach amena: addemistatteri mistatteri, i mizdabbeni lichaltu, ka mashma lan.
Tanu rabbanan: "kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato", ma talmud lomar? minnayin lechohen shehikdish sede chermo, shello yomar: hoil veyotza lakkohanim, vahare hi tachat yadi — tehe shelli.
Vedin hu: beshel acherim ani zoche, beshel atzmi lo kol shekken? talmud lomar: "vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel kodesh laAdonai kisde hacherem".

Vechi ma lamadnu missede hacherem meatta? hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed, makkish sede chermo lisde achuzza shel yisrael: ma sede achuzza shel yisrael yotza mittachat yado umitchalleket lakkohanim, af sede chermo yotza mittachat yado umitchalleket leechav hakkohanim.
Amar mar: beshel acherim ani zoche. mi dame? hatam zoche bealma, hacha ka shakel leh.
Amar rame bar chama: itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "veish et kodashav lo yihyu", ha name ki kodashav damya.
Mi dame? kodashav lav birshuto, hacha birshuto.
Ella amar rav nachman: itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "ki achuzzat olam hu lahem", ha name achuzzato hi, ka mashma lan "achuzzato" — achuzzato in, chermo la.
Hadaran alach hammocher sadehu, uselika lah massechet arachin.
Mishna hakkol memirin, echad anashim veechad nashim. lo sheadam rashshay lehamir, ella sheim hemir — mumar, vesofeg et haarbaim.
Gemara ha gufa kashya: amrat "hakkol memirin" — lechattechilla, vahadar tane "lo sheadam rashshay lehamir ella sheim hemir mumar" — diavad!
Vetisbera "hakkol memirin" — lechattechilla? addekashya lach mimmatnitin, tikshe lach kera! dichtiv "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto".
Ella amar rav yehuda: hachi katane — hakkol matpisin bitmura, echad anashim veechad nashim, lo sheadam rashshay lehamir, sheim hemir — mumar, vesofeg et haarbaim.
Hakkol leetoye may? leetoye yoresh, udela kerabbi yehuda.
Ditnan: yoresh somech, yoresh memir — divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: yoresh eno somech, veyoresh eno memir.
May tama derabbi yehuda? — yalef techillat hekdesh missof hekdesh: ma sof hekdesh — yoresh eno somech, af techillat hekdesh — yoresh eno memir.
Usemicha gufa menalan? telat "korbano" ketivi: chad — "korbano" velo korban goy, vechad — "korbano" velo korban chavero, vechad — "korbano" velo korban aviv.
Ulerabbi meir deamar yoresh somech, vehachtiv "korbano"! hahu mibbee leh lerabbot kol baale chovrin lismicha.

Verabbi yehuda, baale chovrin lismicha let leh. may tama? deha la meyachad korban didhu. veibbaet ema: leolam it leh, vekorban goy vekorban chavero mechad kera nafka, deiyyaytar leh chad levaale chovrin lismicha.
Verabbi meir deamar yoresh memir, may tama? amar lach: "im hamer yamir" lerabbot hayyoresh,
b: Veyalef sof hekdesh mittechillat hekdesh, ma techillat hekdesh yoresh memir, af sof hekdesh yoresh somech.

Rabbi yehuda, hay "veim hamer yamir" may aved leh? lerabbot et haishsha. vechidtanya: lefi shekkol hainyan kullo eno medabber ella leshon zachar, shenneemar: "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto", ishsha minnayin? talmud lomar: "veim hamer yamir" lerabbot et haishsha.
Ulerabbi meir, ishsha mena leh? nafka leh mivveim". verabbi yehuda, "veim" la daresh.

Uven rabbi meir uven rabbi yehuda, tama derabbi kera leishsha, ha la rabbeyay kera — hava amena: ki avda temura la lakya. vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: "ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam" — hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol ovnashin shebbattora!

Itzterich, mahu detema: hane mille onesh deshave ben beyachid ben betzibbur, aval hacha, kevan deonesh sheeno shave bakkol hu, ditnan: en hatztzibbur vehashshuttafin osin temura — ishsha name ki avda la lakya, ka mashma lan.

Bae rame bar chama: katan mahu sheyyamir? hechi dame? illema bekatan shello higgia leonat nedarim — la tibbee lach, dechevan akdoshe la akdesh, amore memayr? ella ki kamibbaya leh — bekatan shehiggia leonat nedarim.

Mi amrinan, kevan deamar mar: "ish", ma talmud lomar "ki yafli neder" — lerabbot mufela hassamuch leish, dekodsho kadosh. middeakdoshe makdesh, amore name memayr, o dilma: kevan delav bar uneshin hu, bitmura la mittefis?

Im timtze lomar katan aved temura, deha ate lichlal ovnashin, goy mahu sheyyamir? mi amrat middeakdoshe makdesh, detanya: "ish ish", ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? lerabbot et haggoyim, shennodrim nedarim unedavot keyisrael, amore name memayr. o dilma: kevan dela ate lichlal ovnashin, ki aved temura la kadsha?

Amar rava: ta shema, detanya: kodshe goyim — lo nehenin velo moalin, veen chayyayvin alehem mishshum piggul, notar vetame, en osin temura, veen meviin alehem nesachim, aval korbano taun nesachim, divre rabbi shimon.
Amar rabbi yose: bechullan ani roe lehachemir. bamme devarim amurim? bekodshe mizbeach, aval bekodshe bedek habbayit moalin bahen. katane miha: en osin temura!
Verame bar chama, behikdish goy lehitkapper goy — la kamibbaya li, ki kamibbaya li — behikdish goy umitkapper beyisrael: batar makdish azlinan, o batar mitkapper azlinan?
Tifshot leh midderabbi avahu, deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: hammakdish mosif chomesh, umitkapper ose temura, vehattorem mishshello

a: Al shel chavero — tovat hanaa shello!

Amar leh: hatam hu dekaate mikkoach yisrael, mishshum hachi azlinan batar mitkapper, vehave leh techillato vesofo beyad yisrael. aval hacha, hachi ka mibbaya leh: mi baenan mittechilla vead sof deteku birshut man deaved temura? teku.
Amar mar: mukedshe goyim lo nehenin velo moalin. lo nehenin — midderabbanan, velo moalin — middeorayyta.
May tama? dichtiv: "nefesh ki timol maal vechata bishgaga", veyalfinan "chet" "chet" mitteruma, uvitruma ketiv: "bene yisrael", velo goyim.
Veen chayyayvin alehem, mishshum piggul, notar, vetame, dichtiv ba betumea: "dabber el aharon veel banav veyinnazru mikkodshe vene yisrael velo yechallelu et shem vegomer".
Veyalef notar "chillul" "chillul" mittumea, dichtiv gabbe tumea: "vene yisrael velo yechalleluvego", uchetiv gabbe notar: "veochlav avono yissa ki et kodesh Adonai chillel".

Veyalef piggul "avon" "avon" minnotar, dichtiv gabbe piggul: "vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu avonah tissa", uchetiv gabbe notar: "veochlav avono yissa ki et kodesh Adonai chillel", vechullehu bene yisrael velo goyim.
Veen osin temura, dichtiv: "lo yachalifennu velo yamir", uchetiv beresh inyan: "dabber el bene yisrael lemor ish ki yafli neder beerkecha".

Lishshana acharina: veen osin temura, may tama? deittakkasha temurat behema lemasar behema, umasar behema lemaaser dagan. vegabbe masar dagan ketiv: "(kol) [ki et] masar bene yisrael asher yarimu laAdonai... bene yisrael" — velo goyim.

Veen mevi (alehen) nesachim, aval korbano taun nesachim, divre rabbi shimon. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ezrach" — ezrach mevi nesachim veen haggoy mevi nesachim. yachol lo tehe olato teuna nesachim? talmud lomar "kacha".
Amar rabbi yose: roe ani bechullan lehachemir. may tama? "laAdonai" ketiv beh.

Bamme devarim amurim — bekodshe mizbeach, aval bekodshe bedek habbayit — moalin bahen. may tama? dechi gamrinan meila "chet" "chet" mitteruma, duvmya ditruma (dekadosh) [dikdosha] kedushshat hagguf, aval bekadshe bedek habbayit dikdushshat damim — la.
Amar rav yehuda, amar rav: kol "lo taase" battora, asa (bah) maase — chayyayv, lo asa (bah) maase — patur.
Uchelala hu delav sheen bo maase patur? vahare memer, delav sheen bo maase hu, velake, ditnan: "lo shehu rashshay lehamir, ella sheim hemir mumar, vesofeg et haarbaim".
Amar lecha rav: ha manni? rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: lav sheen bo maase — lokin alav.
Umi matzet mokmat lematnitin kerabbi yehuda? veha okemta leresha dela kerabbi yehuda, dekatane "hakkol memirin", "hakkol" leetoye may? leetoye yoresh, udela kerabbi yehuda!

Hay tanna savar la kevavteh bachada — delav sheen bo maase lokin alav, ufelig aleh bachada — deillu rabbi yehuda savar: yoresh eno somech, yoresh eno memir, vetanna didan savar: yoresh somech, yoresh memir.

Amar rav idi bar avin, amar rav amram, amar rabbi yitzchak, amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose haggelili: kol lo taase shebbattora, asa bo maase — loke, lo asa bo maase — patur, chutz minnishba, umemer, umekallel chavero bashshem, af al pi shello asa maase — chayyayv. mishshum rabbi yose berabbi chanina amru: af hammakdim teruma levikkurim.
Nishba menalan? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir: amar kera "ki lo yenakke Adonai et asher yissa et shemo lashshav", bet din shel mala
b: En menakkin oto, aval bet din shel matta malkin oto umenakkin oto.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: veema la tihve leh nekiyyut kelal! amar leh: im ken, lichtov kera "lo yinnake" velishtok, "Adonai" lema li? bet din shel mala hu deen menakkin oto, aval bet din shel matta malkin umenakkin oto.
Ashkechan shevuat shav, shevuat sheker menalan? rabbi yochanan dideh amar: "lashshav" "lashshav" shene peamim, im eno inyan lishvuat shav — tenehu inyan lishvuat sheker, deloke.

Matkef la rabbi avahu: shevuat sheker hechi dame? i nema daamar "shello ochal" vaachal — hatam (hu) maase avad, veella deamar "sheochal" vela achal — hahu mi lake? vehaittemar: "shevua sheochal kikkar ze hayyom" veavar hayyom velo achal — rabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish amri: eno loke.
Rabbi yochanan omer: eno loke, delav sheen bo maase hu, vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav. veresh lakish amar: eno loke, mishshum dehave leh hateraat safek, vechol hateraat safek en lokin alav!
Ella amar rabbi avahu: tehe beachalti" velo achalti".
Umay shena deka merabbe "achalti" velo achalti" meochal" velo achal? amar rava: beferush ribbeta tora sheker dome leshav, ma shav lesheavar, af sheker lesheavar.

Etiveh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi avahu: "shevua shello ochal kikkar zo", "shevua shello ochlenna", "shevua shello ochlenna", vaachalah — eno chayyayv ella achat. vezohi shevuat bittuy, shechayyayvin al zedonah makkot, veal shiggatah korban ole veyored. zohi lemaote may? lav lemaote "achalti" velo "achalti", dela lake?
Lo, zo hi deal shiggatah mayyte korban, aval "achalti" velo achalti" la mayyte korban. umanni? rabbi yishmael hi, deamar: eno chayyayv ella al heatid lavo, aval milka lake.
Ema sefa: zohi shevuat shav shechayyayvin al zedonah makkot, veal shiggatah patur. "zohi" lemaote may? lav lemaote "achalti" velo achalti", dela lake?
Lo, zohi deal shiggatah patur mikkorban, aval "achalti" velo achalti" — mayyte korban. umanni? rabbi akiva hi, deamar: meviin korban lesheavar.
Veha amrat resha rabbi yishmael! ella, middesefa rabbi akiva — resha name rabbi akiva, veresha lav lemaote "achalti" velo achalti", ella lemaote "ochal" velo achal.
Umay shena, mishshum dekae bilhabba — memaet lehabba, kae bilhabba — memaet lesheavar?
Umemer. amar leh rabbi yochanan letanna: la titni "umemer", mishshum divdibburo asa maase.

Hamekallel et chavero bashshem. menalan? amar rabbi elazar, amar rabbi oshaya: amar kera "im lo tishmor", uchetiv "vehifla Adonai et makkotcha". hafelaa zo eni yodea mahu, keshehu omer "vehippilo hashshofet vehikkahu lefanav" — heve omer: hafelaa zo malkot.
Emar: afillu shevuat emet? behedya ketiv: "shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem".
Emar hane mille lefayyes et chavero, aval milka lilke? la matzet amrat, dehachtiv "uvishmo tishshavea".

Hahu mibbee leh lechidrav, deamar rav giddel amar rav: minnayin shennishbain lekayyem et hammitzvot? shenneemar: "nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha". hachtiv kera acharina: "uvo tidbak uvishmo tishshavea".
Ella lemay ata — limkallel et chavero bashshem. veema — lemotzi shem shamayim levattala? mi gara mekallel et chavero bashshem mimmotzi shem shamayim levattala?

Anan, hachi ka kashya lan: ema motzi shem shamayim levattala — tisge leh bemalkot, aval mekallel chavero bashshem, kevan dekaaved tarte, deka mappek shem shamayim levattala vekamtzaar leh lechavreh — la tisge leh bemalkot!

a: La matzet amrat, dichtiv "lo tekallel cheresh", vei amrat bishlama lekallel et chavero — azharteh mehacha dichtiv "lo tekallel cheresh", ella i amrat motzi shem shamayim levattala — azharteh mehecha?
Allema la? vehachtiv: "et Adonai elohecha tira veoto taavod"! hahu azharat ase hu.

Mishshum rabbi yose berabbi chanina amru: af hammakdim teruma levikkurim. may tama derabbi yose berabbi chanina? amar kera: "meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher" — "melea" ellu bikkurim, "vedimacha" ellu teruma, veamrat "lo teacher".

Ittemar: hikdim teruma levikkurim, rabbi elazar verabbi yose berabbi chanina, chad amar: loke, vechad amar: eno loke. tistayyem derabbi yose berabbi chanina hu deamar loke, middeamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: af hammakdim teruma levikkurim loke.
Adderabba, tistayyem derabbi elazar hu deamar loke, ditnan: hayu lefanav shete kalkallot shel tevel, veamar: "maaser shel zo bazo" — harishona meusseret.
"Shel zo bazo veshel zo bazo" — harishona meusseret, vehashsheniyya enah meusseret. "maasrotehem masar kalkalla bachavertah" — kera et hashshem.
Veittemar, rabbi elazar amar: loke, mippene shehikdim maaser sheni shebbah lemaaser rishon shebbachavertah. tistayyem.
Ella rabbi yose berabbi chanina, deamar eno loke, lema kashya derabbi yose berabbi chanina adderabbi yose berabbi chanina!
La, rabbi yose berabbi chanina
b: Appetura kae, vehachi kaamar: lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav. mishshum rabbi yose berabbi chanina amru: af hammakdim teruma levikkurim.
Umay shena memer delake, mishshum divdibburo asa maase? makdim teruma levikkurim name lilke, mishshum divdibburo asa maase!
Amar rabbi avin: shane hatam, delav shennittak laase hu, dichtiv: "mikkol maserotechem tarimu".
Yatev rav dimi vekaamar la leha shemata, amar leh abbaye: vechol lav shennittak laase la lake?
Veha memer, delav shennittak laase hu, velake, ditnan: lo sheadam rashshay lehamir, ella sheim hemir — mumar, vesofeg et haarbaim.
Have lehu tere lave vechad ase, vela ate chad ase veakar tere lave.
Vahare ones, dechad lav vechad ase, vela ate chad ase veakar lav, detanya: ones sheggerash — im yisrael hu machzir veeno loke, veim kohen hu loke veeno machzir!
Kohanim kaamrat?! kohanim — tama achrina hu, derabbi rachamana kedushsha yattira.
Ketannae: "lo yashiru mimmennu ad boker" — ba hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase, lomar sheen lokin alav, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yaakov omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase — en lokin alav. mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar lokin alav.
Verabbi yaakov, hay "vehannotar mimmennu ad boker baesh tisrofu" lemay ata?

Mibbee leh lichditnan: haatzamot, vehaggidin, vehannotar — yissarfu beshishsha asar. chal shishsha asar lihyot bashshabbat — yissarfu beshiva asar, lefi sheen dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov.
Veamar chizkiyya, vechen tana deve chizkiyya: may tama? amar kera "vehannotar mimmennu ad boker baesh tisrofu" — ba hakkatuv litten boker sheni lisrefato.
Amar abbaye: kol milleta deamar rachamana la taaved, im aved — mahane, dei salka datach la mahane — ammay lake? rava amar: la mahane midde, vehay delake — mishshum daavar ammemra derachamana hu.

a: Metivi: ones sheggeresh, im yisrael hu — machzir veeno loke, vei amrat kevan daavar ammemra derachamana lake, ha name lilke! teyuveta derava.
Amar lach: shane hatam, deamar kera "kol yamav", kol yamav baamod vehachezer.
Uleabbaye, i lav daamar rachamana "kol yamav", hava amena issura hu daavad leh, i bae lehdar vei bae la lehdar, ka mashma lan.
Lishshana acharina. metivi: ones sheggeresh — im yisrael hu machzir veeno loke, veim kohen hu loke veeno machzir. katane: "im yisrael hu machzir" — teyuveta deabbaye!
Shane hatam, derachamana amar: "kol yamav", kol yamav baamod vehachezer".

Verava amar lach: i la ketav rachamana "kol yamav", hava amena: lilke velehdar, dehave leh lav gereda, dichtiv: "lo yuchal leshallechah". ahachi ketav kera "kol yamav", leshauoyeh leones lelo taase shennittak laase, deen lokin alav.
Vahare torem min haraa al hayyafa, derachamana amar: "mikkol chelbo".
Chelbo — in, geruin — la. utenan: en tormin min haraa al hayyafa, veim taram — terumato teruma. alma mahane, teyuveta derava.

Amar lach rava: shane hatam, kerabbi ila, deamar rabbi ila: minnayin letorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma? shenneemar: "velo tisu alav chet baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu". im eno kadosh, nesiut chet lamma? mikkan lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma.
Uleabbaye, i lav deamar rachamana "velo tisu alav chet", hava amena hachi amar rachamana: aved mitzva min hammuvechar, vei la aved — "chote" la mikkere, ka mashma lan.

Vahare mimmin al sheeno mino, deamar rachamana "kol chelev yitzhar", litten chelev laze vechelev laze, utenan: en tormin mimmin al sheeno mino, veim taram — en terumato teruma, alma la mahane, teyuveta deabbaye.
Amar lach abbayye: shane hatam, deamar kera "reshitam" — reshit laze vereshit laze. vechen amar rabbi ila: "reshit".
Ulerava, i lav deamar rachamana "reshit", hava amena tirosh veyitzhar, dichtiv behu "chelev" "chelev", deen tormin mizze al ze.
Aval tirosh vedagan, dagan vedagan, dechad "chelev" ketiv behu, ki tarem mehay ahay — la lake. ketav rachamana "reshit", litten chelev laze vechelev laze.
Lishshana acharina, ha tirosh vedagan, dechad "chelev" ketiv behu — tarem mehay ahay. ketav rachamana "reshit".
Vahare charamim, deamar rachamana: "lo yimmacher velo yiggael", utenan: cherme chohanim en podin otam, ella notnayn lakkohen. alma la mahane, teyuveta deabbaye.
Amar lach: shane hatam, deamar rachamana "kodesh kadashim hu" — bahavavyayto yehe.
b: Ulerava, hay "hu" lemaote bechor, detanya: bivchor neemar "lo tifde" venimkar hu, bemaaser neemar "lo yiggael" veeno nimkar, lo chay velo shachut, lo tam velo baal mum.
Vahare temura, deamar rachamana: "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto", vetana: lo sheadam rashshay lehamir, ella sheim hemir — mumar, vesofeg et haarbaim. alma mahane, teyuveta derava!
Amar lach: shane hatam, deamar kera "vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh".
Uleabbaye, i lav deamar rachamana "vehaya hu utemurato", hava amena tetze zo vetikkanes zo, kamashma lan.
Vahare bechor, deamar rachamana "lo tifde", utenan: yesh lahen pidyon, velitmurotehen pidyon, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser, alma la mahane, teyuveta deabbaye.
Amar lach: shane hatam, deamar kera "hem", bahavavyaytan yehu.
Ulerava, hay "hem" lema leh? hen kerevin, veen temuratan kerevin.
Uleabbaye — hay sevara mena leh? "im shor im se laAdonai hu" — laAdonai karev, veen temurato kereva.
Verava, in hachi name demehahu kera, ella "hem" lema li? limmed al bechor umaaser shennitarev daman bechol haolin shekkerevin legabbe mizbeach.

Veabbaye, hay sevara mena leh? mivvelakach middam happar umiddam hassair", vahalo dam happar merubbe mishshel sair! mikkan laolin sheen mevattelin ze et ze, detanya: "velakach middam happar umiddam hassair" — sheyyehu meoravin, divre rabbi yoshiyya.
Verava, hatam — mizze bifne atzmo umizze bifne atzmo, vesavar la kerabbi yonatan.
Vahare maaser, deamar rachamana "lo yiggael", utenan: yesh lahen pidyon velitmurotehen, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser, alma la mahane, teyuveta deabbaye.
Amar lach: shane hatam, deyalef "avara" "avara" mibbechor.
Hare hikdimah teruma labbikkurim, deamar rachamana "meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher", utenan: hammakdim, af al pi shehu belo taase — ma sheasa asuy!
Amar lach rava: shane hatam, deamar kera "mikkol maserotechem tarimu teruma".
Uleabbaye mibbaya leh, kidamar rav pappa leabbaye: ella meatta, afillu hikdimo bichri name nippetar!
Amar leh: alecha amar kera "mikkol maserotechem tarimu".
Ma raita lerabbot et hakkeri ulehotzi et hashshibbolin? merabbe ani et hakkeri, sheyyeshno bichlal diggun, umotzi ani et hashshibbolin, sheenan bichlal diggun.
Vahare almana lechohen gadol, derachamana amar "almana ugerusha... lo yikkach", utenan: kol makom sheyyesh kiddushin veyesh avera — havvalad holech achar happagum.
Shane hacha, deamar kera: "lo yechallel zaro".
Uleabbaye, nema kera "lo yachel", may "lo yechallel"? echad lo, veechad lah.
Vahare hikdish baale mumin lammizbeach, derachamana amar: "kol asher bo mum lo takrivu", utenan: hammakdish baale mumin legabbe mizbeach, af al pi shehu belo taase — ma sheasa asuy, teyuveta derava!
Amar lach rava: shane hatam, deamar kera "uleneder lo yeratze" — ritztzuy hu dela meratztze, ha mikdash kadshi.
Uleabbaye, i dela amar rachamana "uleneder lo yeratze", hava amena: keover mitzva vechasher, kamashma lan.
Vahare makdish temimin levedek habbayit, deamar rachamana:

a: "Nedava taase oto" — ze kodshe bedek habbayit, utenan: hammakdish temimin levedek habbayit, af al pi shehu belo taase — ma sheasa asuy. teyuveta derava!
Amar lach [rava]: mimmakom shennitrabbu baale mumin legabbe mizbeach, nitrabbu temimin levedek habbayit.
Vahare gazel, derachamana amar "lo tigzol", utenan: haggozel etzim vaasaan kelim, tzemer vaasaan begadim — meshallem kishat haggezela, teyuveta derava!
Amar lach rava: shane hatam, deamar kera "asher gazal" — kema sheggazal.
Uleabbaye, hay "asher gazal" mibbee leh: al gezelo shello mosif chomesh, al gezelo shel aviv eno mosif chomesh.
Vahare mashkon, derachamana amar: "lo tavo el beto laavot avoto", utenan: machazir et hakkar ballayla veet hammacharesha bayyom — teyuveta derava!
Amar lach rava: shane hatam, deamar kera "hashev tashiv".
Uleabbaye, i lav deamar rachamana "hashev tashiv", hava amena issura avad, i bae nayhdar vei bae la nahdar, ka mashma lan. (chaser lishana acharina)

Vahare pea, derachamana amar: "lo techalle peat sadcha bekutzerecha", utenan: mitzvat pea lehaferish min hakkama, lo hifrish min hakkama — yafrish min hoomarim, lo hifrish min hoomarim — yafrish min hakkeri ad shello mercho.
Mercho — meassero venoten lo; mishshum rabbi yishmael amru: af mafrish min haissa, teyuveta deabbaye!
Amar lach abbayye: shane hatam, deamar kera "taazov", "taazov" yattira.
Verava amar lach: yesh lecha aziva acheret shekkazo, veezo? ze hammafkir karmo.
Detanya: hammafkir karmo, vehishkim lashshachar uvetzaro — chayyayv beferet veolelot, beshichcha uvefea, ufatur min hammaaser.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: vehasheta deshanninan kol hane shinnuye, deabbaye verava bemay peligi?
Beribbit ketzutza kamippalgi, vechidrabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: ribbit ketzutza yotza bedayyaynin,
b: Avak ribbit enah yotza bedayyaynin, verabbi yochanan amar: afillu ribbit ketzutza enah yotza bedayyaynin.

Amar leh: hatam bisvara peligi? hatam bikrae peligi! deamar rabbi yitzchak: may tama derabbi yochanan? amar kera: "banneshech natan vetarbit lakach vachay lo yichye", lechayyim nittan velo lehishshavon.
Rav acha bar adda amar mehacha: "veyareta meelohecha... ani Adonai" — lemora netattiv, velo lehishshavon.

Rava amar mehacha: "hattoevot hael asa mot yumat damav bo yihye", "veholid ben paritz shofech dam" — hukkeshu malve ribbit leshofche damim: ma shofche damim lo nittenu lehishshavon, af malve ribbit lo nittenu lehishshavon.
Veamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: may tama derabbi elazar? deamar kera: "veche achicha immach" — ahdar leh, ki hechi deneche immach.
Veella bemay kamippalgi abbaye verava? beshinnuy kone.
Lishshana acharina, behane shinnuye deshanninan, beribbit ketzutza — leabbaye la mahdar ribbit, lerava mahdar ribbit.

Veha abbaye name savar mappekinan ribbit ketzutza bedayyaynin! deamar abbaye: haden demassek bechavreh arba zuze beribbita, vihavoy leh lemalve (bechanuteh) [begavvayyhu] gelima deshave chamsha bearbea — ki mappekinan minneh, arbea mappekinan minneh, vehay zuza bemattana hu dihav leh. verava amar: chamsha mappekinan minneh. may tama? kulla betorat ribbita kaate lideh!
Ella, ki ka mippalgi abbaye verava beshinnuy kone.

Tanu rabbanan: "kol asher bo mum lo takrivu", ma talmud lomar? im belo tishchatu" — hare kevar amur lematta! ella ma talmud lomar "bal takrivu"? — "bal takdishu". mikkan amru: hammakdish baale mumin legabbe mizbeach over mishshum chamishsha shemot.

Mishshum "bal takrivu", "bal takdishu", "bal tishchatu", umishshum "bal tizreku", umishshum "bal taktiru kullo", umishshum "bal taktiru miktzato". mishshum rabbi yose berabbi yehuda amru: af kabbalat haddam.

Amar mar: im "bal tishchatu" — hare amur lematta. hechan amur? detanya: "avveret o shavur o charutz o yabbelet lo takrivu" — ma talmud lomar? im "bal takdishu" — hare kevar amur lemala, ella ma talmud lomar "bal takrivu"? — "bal tishchatu".
"Veishshe lo tittenu mehem" — ellu ishshim, en li ella kullan, miktzatan minnayin? talmud lomar: "mehem".
Zerikat damim minnayin? talmud lomar: "al hammizbeach", "laAdonai" — lerabbot sair hammishtalleach.
Vela" — lerabbot hu? vehatanya: i "korban" — shomea ani af kodshe bedek habbayit, shennikreu "korban", keinyan shenneemar: "vannakrev et korban Adonai"!
Talmud lomar "veel petach ohel moed vegomer" — harauy lefetach ohel moed chayyayvin alav mishshum shochate chutz, sheen rauy lefetach ohel moed en chayyayvin alav mishshum shochate chutz.
Otzi ani et ellu, velo otzi parat chattat vesair hammishtalleach, shehen reuyin lefetach ohel moed — talmud lomar "laAdonai", mi shemmeyuchadin laAdonai, yatzu ellu sheen meyuchadin laAdonai.
Amar rava: hatam, meinyayna dikra, "veel petach" — lerabbot, "laAdonai" — lehotzi; hacha, deishshe" — lehotzi, "laAdonai" — lerabbot.
Tama dichtav kera "laAdonai" hu dela mayyte sair hammishtalleach, ha la rabbi kera "laAdonai" hava amena sair hammishtalleach baal mum shappir dame. mikkedi, en haggoral kovea ella bedavar harauy!
Amar rav yosef: ha manni? chanan hammitzri hi, deamar: afillu dam bechos — mevi chavero umezavvevg lo.
Nehi deshamat leh lechanan hammitzri, dela have dichuy, dela tzerich hagerala — mi shamat leh? dilma mayyte umagril!
Ella amar rav yosef: ha manni? rabbi shimon hi, detanya: met echad mehen — mevi chavero belo hagerala, divre rabbi shimon.
Rava amar: lo nitzrecha, kegon shehumam bo bayyom vechillelo al chavero.

a: Salka datach amena: bishlama meikkara la yadana i hay mikkeva lashshem, aval hacha, kevan deinnechar shem — la lake, ka mashma lan.

Amar mar: mishshum rabbi yose berabbi yehuda af kabbalat haddam. may tama derabbi yose berabbi yehuda? amar kera: "umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut vegomer" — zo kabbalat haddam, sheamar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda.
Uletanna kamma, hay "lo takrivu" lema li? mibbee leh lizrikat damim. veha nafka leh meal hammizbeach"? orcheh dikra demishtae hachi.

Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda name, orcheh dikra hu? in hachi name. ella kabbalat haddam mena leh? nafka leh meha: "umiyyad ben nechar lo takrivu" — zo hi kabbalat haddam sheamar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda.

Uletanna kamma, hay "lo takrivu" lema li? mibbee leh lehay: salka datach amena, hoil velo nitztauu bene noach ella al mechussar evarim, la shena bemizbeach didhu vela shena bemizbeach didan, ka mashma lan.
Lishshana acharina: rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: af al kabbalat haddam. may tama? dichtiv: "umauch vechatut... lo takrivu" — zo kabbalat haddam, uzerika nafka leh meal hammizbeach".
Ulerabbanan name tippok lehu zerika min "al hammizbeach"! hachi name, veella "lo takrivu" demauch lemay ata? mappekinan [leh] levamat yachid.
Ulerabbi yose berabbi yehuda, hay mibbee leh levamat yachid? in hachi name, ella "takrivu" dekabbala mena leh? "miyyad ben nechar lo takrivu" — zo kabbalat haddam.
Verabbanan itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uvene noach en metzvvivyn ella al mechussar ever bevama dilhon, dilma anan name nekabbel minnehon? ka mashma lan "mikkol elle" dela mekabbelinan.
Matkef la resh lakish: shemma lo shaninu ella betam shennaasa baal mum, veover, dei baal mum meikkara — dikla bealma hu!
Amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar yosef: "sarua vekalut" ketiv bapparasha, vehane baale mumin meikkara ninhu.
Amar leh: shemma lo shaninu ella bitmura, ditnan: chomer battemura mibbazzevach, shekken kedushsha chala aleha al baal mum kavua.

Amar leh rabbi yochanan: la shemia lach ha deamar rabbi yannay, bachavura nimnu vegamru: hammakdish baal mum legabbe mizbeach over mishshum chamishsha shemot, vei bitmura name — shishsha havvyayn, deikka name lav ditmura! ella may — bevaal mum meikkaro? ammay lake? dikla bealma hu!
Amar leh: dikla — lav zila milleta, min etzim hu; baal mum meikkara — zila milleta, kevan dishvek temimim veakdesh baale mumin — michayyayv.
Lishshana acharina, amar leh: afillu hachi bazya milleta, dedekel lekka bemino — la lake, leappoke baal mum, kevan deikka bemino — lake.
Amar rava: hasheta daamur tama devaal mum delake — mishshum devazya milletayyhu, afillu (lammakdish) [makdesh] leh lidme nesachim — name lake.
Tanya kevavteh derava:
b: "Nedava taase oto" — ze kodshe bedek habbayit, veen li ella nedava, neder minnayin? talmud lomar: "uleneder".

Yachol afillu kodshe mizbeach? talmud lomar "uleneder lo yeratze", ze kodshe mizbeach. veen li ella neder, nedava minnayin? talmud lomar "nedava". rabbi omer: "lo yeratze" — beharetzaat gufo hakkatuv medabber.
Hayeynu tanna kamma! may lav beha kamippalgi, detanna kamma savar: afillu akdesheh lidme nesachim — name lake, verabbi savar: beharetzaat gufo — name lake, aval bidme nesachim — la lake. shema minna.
Veella "oto" lema li? lechidtanya: "nedava taase oto" — "oto" taase nedava, vei atta ose tamim nedava levedek habbayit. mikkan amru: hammakdish temimim levedek habbayit — over baase.
Uminnayin af belo taase — shenneemar "vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor" — limmed al happarasha shehi belav, divre rabbi yehuda.
Amar leh rabbi levar kappara: may mashma? amar leh dichtiv "lemor" — "lo" neemar baddevarim. be rabbi amri: "lo emor".
Ittemar: hammaale evre baale mumin legabbe mizbeach, amar rava: over mishshum "bal taktiru kullo" umishshum "bal taktiru miktzato". amar abbaye: en lokin al lav shebbichlalot.
Metivi: hammakdish baale mumin legabbe mizbeach — over mishshum chamishsha shemot, teyuveta deabbaye.
Amar abbaye: begavre katane! i begavre — "over"?! "ovrin" mibbee leh! ella peshita bechad gavra, uteyuveta deabbaye.
Amar abbaye: appek "haketarat miktzato", veayyel "kabbalat haddam". kabbalat dam — lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda it leh, letanna kamma let leh? kashya!
Lishshana acharina: veha middesefa rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, resha rabbanan. teyuveta deabbaye, teyuveta.

Mishna hakkohanim memirin beshellahen, veyisrael memirin beshellahen. en hakkohanim memirin lo bechattat velo beasham velo bivchor. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: mippene ma en memirin bivchor? amar lo rabbi akiva: chattat veasham mattana lakkohen, uvechor mattana lakkohen. ma chattat veasham en memirin bo, af bechor en memirin bo.

Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: ma lo im eno memir bechattat veasham, sheen zachin bahen bechayyehen, tomar bivchor shezzachin bo bechayyav! amar lo rabbi akiva: vahalo kevar neemar "vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh", hechan kedushsha chala alav? bevet habbealim, af temura bevet habbealim.

Gemara tenan hatam: bechor mochrin oto tam chay, uvaal mum chay veshachut, umekaddeshin bo haishsha. amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella bizman hazze, hoil veit leh lechohen zechiyyay begavvevy (hoil veyesh lakkohen shuttafut bo), aval bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, kevan detam lehakerava hu dekae — en mochrin oto tamim chay.

Etiveh rava lerav nachman: mochrin oto tamim chay — chay in, shachut la. emat? illema bizman hazze — mi ikka tam shachut? ella peshita bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, vekatane name: mochrin oto tamim chay, (alma it leh lechohen zechiyyay begavvevy)!
La, leolam bizman hazze, mi katane: mochrin oto tamim chay — in, shachut — la? hi gufa ata leashmoinan, devizman hazze name mochrin oto tamim chay.

a: Etiveh: bivchor neemar "lo tifde" venimkar hu, bemay askinan? ilema bizman hazze — ema sefa: "veet damam tizrok al hammizbeach", bizman hazze mi ikka mizbeach? ella peshita bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym.
Uvemay? ilema bevaal mum — ema sefa: "veet damam tizrok al hammizbeach veet chelbam taktir" — mi chaze lehakerava?! ella lav betam, vekatane nimkar hu, alma it lehu lechohen zechiyyay begavveh!
Midde irya? resha — bevaal mum, sefa — betam.

Metiv rav mesharsheya: kohenet shennitarevo veladah bivlad shifchatah, higdilu hattaarovot — meshachrerin ze et ze, ushenehem ochlin bitruma, vecholkin chelek echad al haggoren. bechoran yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyeachlu bemuman.

Bemay askinan? ilema bizman hazze — may shena didan umay shena didhu? didan name mumin baenan! ella lav bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym? i amrat bishlama it lehu lechohen zechiyyay begavvevy — shappir, ella i amrat let leh — lete gizbar velishkele!
Leolam bizman hazze, udeka kashya lach: may shena didan umay shena didhu? anan yahavinan leh lechohen bemumayyhu, inhu — kevan deikka behu miktzat kohen, mafka leh lechohanim.

Lishshana acharina: bizman hazze, may irya bechorot dehalen sefekot? afillu didan name yiru! ella peshita bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, vei bevaal mum — yiru ad sheyyistaavu? ha mesoavin vekayymin! ella peshita betammin, vehachi hu dela mezabbeni vadday.

Leolam bizman hazze, may kashya lach, afillu dilan name yiru? la (matzinu) [matzenan] medachenan leh lechohen, dela it kan sefek kehunna. hane sefekot medachu lechohen, kol chad vechad amar leh lechohen: daana kohen vaana kohen.
Metivi: rabbi shimon omer: "behemtah" — perat levehemat bechor umaaser shebbah, "shelalah" — perat lechesef maaser sheni shebbah.
Bemay askinan? ilema bizman hazze — mi ikka ir hanniddachat? vehatnan: en osin ir hanniddachat ella bevet din shel shivim veechad! ella peshita bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym.

Uvemay? i nema bevaal mum — hayeynu "behemtah"! ella peshita betam. vei amrat bishlama it leh zechiyyay begavveh — shappir, ella i amrat let leh — lema li mibbehema? tippok leh mishshelalah", velo shelal shamayim!
Leolam bevaal mum, udeka kashya lach hayeynu "behemtah" — mi shenneechol betorat "behemtah", yatzu bechor umaaser (sheeno bichlal) [sheen neechalin betorat] "behemtah".
Ditnan: kol pesule hammukedashin nimkarin baitliz, venishchatin baitliz, venishkalin belitra, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser, shehanaatan labbealim.
Metivi: "umaala maal baAdonai" — lerabbot kodashim kallim, shehen mamon bealim, divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Ben azzay omer: lerabbot shelamim. abba yose ben dosay omer: lo amar ben azzay ella bivchor bilvad.
Bemay askinan? ilema bizman hazze — ha dumeya dishlamim katane! ella peshita bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym.
Uvemay askinan? ilema bevaal mum — ha dumeya dishlamim katane! ella lav betam, ushema minna it leh lechohen zechiyyay begavvevy.
b: Amar abbaye: la, leolam betam, uvivchor bechutza laaretz, verabbi shimon hi deamar: im bau temimin yikrevu.

Metivi: amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri: ma li im eno memer bechattat veasham, shehare en zachin bahen bechayyehen, tomar bivchor shezzachin bechayyav. bemay askinan? ilema bevaal mum — ha dumeya dechattat veasham kaamar, ella lav betam, vekatane zachin bo bechayyav!
Amar ravina: ha name bivchor bechutza laaretz, verabbi shimon hi, deamar: im bau temimim — yikrevu.
Lema ketannae: bechor, bevet habbealim — osin temura, bevet hakkohen — en osin temura. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kevan shebba lide chohen — en osin temura.
Hayeynu tanna kamma! may lav hachi kaamar: bevet kohen — hu ose temura, veen baal ose temura, alma it leh lechohen zechiyyay begavvevy.
La kashya, ha rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ha rabbi akiva.
Amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella kohen lechohen, aval kohen leyisrael — asur. may tama? dilma azel yisrael veshade beh muma, umamte lechacham, veomer lo: "bechor ze natan li kohen bemumo".
Umi share chacham hachi? veha amar rav: en roin bechor leyisrael ella im ken kohen immo!
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hayeynu tama deyisrael asur, mippene shennire kechohen hamesayyea bevet haggoranot.
Mar zutera ikkela leve rav ashe. amaru leh: litom mar midde. ayyto lekammeh bisra. amar leh: lechol mar, demayvre mishshum devuchera hu. mena lechu ha? amaru leh: dezabben lan peloni kohen.
Amar lehu: la sevira lechu ha deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua, mippene shennire kechohen hamesayyea bevet haggoranot? amaru leh: la sevira lan, daanan mizban ka zavninan.

Amar lehu: vela sevira lechu haditnan: ad kamma yisrael chayyayv littappel babbechor? baddakka — sheloshim yom, uvegassa — chamishshim yom. veim amar lo: "tenehu li betoch zemanno" — hare ze lo yittenennu lo. veamar rav sheshet: ma taam? mippene shennire kechohen hamesayyea bevet haggoranot!
Amaru leh: hatam mochcha milleta, hacha mizban ka zavninan.
Lashon acher, amaru leh: hacha la yahev deme, hacha ka yahev deme. may amrat? mozel kohen gabbeh, desavar kohen dechi have leh bechor acharina yahev nihaleh? la, demassek addateh:

a: Butzina tav mikkara.

Mishna memirin min hatztzon al habbakar, umin habbakar al hatztzon, umin hakkevasim al haizzim, umin haizzim al hakkevasim, min hazzecharim al hannekevot, umin hannekevot al hazzecharim, min hattemimim al baale mumin, min baale mumin al hattemimim.
Shenneemar: "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov bera o ra betov", veezehu "tov bera"? baale mumin shekkadam hekdeshan et muman.

Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "behema bivhema" — mikkan shemmemirin min hatztzon al habbakar, umin habbakar al hatztzon, min hakkevasim al haizzim, umin haizzim al hakkevasim, umin hazzecharim al hannekevot, umin hannekevot al hazzecharim, umin baale mumin al hattemimim, umin hattemimim al baale mumin.
Yachol afillu kadam mum lehekdeshan? talmud lomar: "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov bera o ra betov", veezehu "tov bera"? baale mumin shekkadam hekdeshan et muman.
May talmuda? amar abbaye: nema kera "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov bera o ra bo", "betov" achrina lema li? shema minna: tov meikkaro ose temura, ra meikkaro en ose temura.

Rava amar: tarvavyyhu "tov" yaytore meyaytri. im ken, nichtov kera "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto bera o ra bo", lema li lemichtav tarvayyhu "tov"? chad "tov" — afillu betov name, ki memir lake. veiddach "tov" — meikkaro ose temura, ra meikkaro en ose temura.
Veabbaye amar: kal vachomer hu, uma tov bera, dealloye ka mealle leh — lake, tov betov, dechi hadade ninhu — lo kol shekken delake!
Verava — en onshin min haddin, veabbayye amar lach: ha lav dina hu, mi gara tov mera?
Tanu rabbanan: "lo yachalifennu" beshel acherim, "velo yamir oto" beshel atzmo. velichtov "lo yachalifennu", vela bae "lo yamir oto"!
I ketav hachi — hava amena: tetze zo vetikkanes zo hu detilke, aval memir detarvavyyhu ka makdesh lehu — ema la lake. ka mashma lan.

Hay beshel acherim, hechi dame? i nema behema dehekdesh dideh, vechullin dealma — mi matze makdesh? "ish ki yakdish et beto kodesh laAdonai" amar rachamana, ma beto birshuto, af kol birshuto. veella behema dehekdesh dealma, vechullin dideh — mi matpes bedavar sheeno shello?
Leolam bivhema dehekdesh dealma, vechullin dideh, kegon deamar mareh divhema dehekdesh: "kol harotze lehamir bivhemto yavo veyamir".

Mishna memirin echad bishnayim, ushenayim beechad, echad bemea, umea beechad. rabbi shimon omer: en memirin ella echad beechad, shenneemar: "vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh", ma "hu" meyuchad, af hi meyuchedet.

Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "behema bivhema" — mikkan shemmemirin echad bishnayim, ushenayim beechad, echad bemea, umea beechad. rabbi shimon omer: en memirin ella echad beechad, shenneemar "behema bivhema", velo behema bivhemot, velo behemot bivhema.
Amar lo: matzinu behemot shekkeruya "behema", shenneemar: "uvehema rabba". verabbi shimon — "behema rabba" ikkeri, "behema" setam la ikkeri.
Vetama derabbi shimon mishshum "behema" hu? veha tama derabbi shimon mishshum "hu", ma "hu" meyuchad — af temura meyuchedet!
Meikkara amar lahen rabbi shimon min "vehaya hu utemurato", vechi chaza dedarshi rabbanan mibbehema bivhema", amar lahem ihu: mehatam name matzenan lemelaf tama didi.

Amar resh lakish: mode rabbi shimon shemmemirin vechozrin umemirin, may tama? kedushsha rishona dehekdesh lehechan halcha?! verabbi yochanan amar: keshem sheen memirin shenayim beechad, ken en memirin vechozrin umemirin.

Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan, tanya kevavteh deresh lakish. tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: keshem sheen memirin echad bishnayim, kach en memirin vechozrin umemirin. tanya kevavteh deresh lakish: yachol keshem sheamar rabbi shimon sheen memirin shenayim beechad, kach en memirin vechozrin umemirin — talmud lomar: "vehaya hu utemurato", afillu bemea.
Bae rabbi avin: ledivre haomer "en memirin vechozrin umemirin", hifrish asham lehitkapper bo, vehemir bo,
b: Vehumam vechillelo al acher, venitkapper beasham acher, venittak leola — mahu sheyyamir bo?
Amar abbaye: may ka mibbaya leh? i shene gufim ukedushsha achat — tibbee leh belo mitkapper.
I shete kedushshot, veguf echad — tibbee leh belo humam!
Verabbi avin, chada miggo chada kamibbaya leh, veim timtze lomar: shene gufin ukedushsha achat — la, mishshum divhahi kedushsha ha ittemar ba chada zimna. shene gufin ushete kedushshot mahu? teku.
Lishshana acharina, bae rabbi avin lerabbi yochanan: deamar en memirin vechozrin umemirin — hifrish asham lehitkapper bo, vehemir bo, vehumam vechillelo al acher, mahu sheyyachzor veyamir?
Nitkapper beasham acher, venittak ze leola, mahu sheyyachazir veyamir?
Amar abbaye: he ka mibbaya leh? kedushsha acheret beoto hagguf — la nive humam vechillelo beacher! i guf (echad) [acher] beotah kedushsha — la nive nitkapper beasham acher!

Verabbi avin, chada miggo chada ka mibbaya leh: humam vechillelo al acher, mahu sheyyachazor veyamir? mi amrinan: beasham rishon hu deen chozer umemir, aval beguf (echad) [acher], af al gav dekaddish otah kedushsha — chozer umemir, o dilma: kol beotah kedushsha en chozer umemir?
Veim timtza lomar haddin guf (echad) [acher], kevan divotah kedushsha kaem — en chozer umemir, ella nitkapper beasham acher, venittak ze rishon leola, mahu sheyyachazir veyamir bo?

Mi amrinan: ki en memir vechozer umemir — hane mille oto hagguf beotah kedushsha, aval oto hagguf bikdushsha acheret — chozer umemir, o dilma: af al kedushsha acheret, kevan deoto hagguf hu — en chozer umemir? teku.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hekdesh rishon mosif chomesh, veen hekdesh sheni mosif chomesh.
Amar rav pappa: may tama derabbi yehoshua ben levi? amar kera: "veim hammakdish yigal et beto veyasaf chamishit" — makdish, velo hammatpis.
Bae rabbi avin: hifrish asham lehitkapper bo, vehumam, vehosif alav chomesh, vechillelo chavero, venitkapper beasham acher, venittak ze leola — mahu sheyyosif alav chomesh?
Amar abbaye: may ka mibbaya leh? i shene gufin ukedushsha achat ka mibbaya leh — tibbee leh belo nitkapper!
I shete kedushshot, veguf echad ka mibbaya leh — tibbee belo humam!
Verabbi avin, chada miggo chada kamibbaya leh: im timtza lomar shene gufin ukedushsha achat la — mishshum divhahi kedushsha ittosaf ba chada zimna chomesh, shene gufin ushete kedushshot may? teku.
Lishshana acharina, bae rabbi avin: hifrish asham lehitkapper bo, vehumam vechillelo al acher vehosif chomesh, nitkapperu beasham acher, venittak ze leola — mahu sheyyosif alav chomesh?
Amar abbaye: haden ka mibbaya leh, i kedushsha acheret beoto hagguf ka mibbaya leh — la nibbee leh humam, i guf (echad) [acher] beotah kedushsha kulei.
Vechillelo al acher, mahu sheyyosif alav chomesh? mi amrinan: beasham kamma hu demosef, aval beguf (echad) [acher], af al gav dekaem beotah kedushsha, [en] mosif chomesh,

a: O dilma: kol otah kedushsha eno mosif chomesh?

Veim timmatze lomar haden guf (echad) [acher], kevan divotah kedushsha kaem [eno] mosif chomesh, ella nitkapper beacher, venittak ze leola — mahu? ki [eno] mosif chomesh beoto hagguf beotah kedushsha, aval bikdushsha acheret — la? o dilma, kevan deoto hagguf hu — [eno] mosif chomesh? teku.
Bae rame bar chama: makdish mosif chomesh, o (mechapper) [mitkapper] mosif chomesh? amar rava: amar kera "veim hammakdish yigal et beto" — makdish, velo mitkapper.
Bae rame bar chama: makdish ose temura, o mitkapper ose temura? amar rava: im ken, matzinu tzibbur veshuttafin osin temura, kegon deshauo shaliach leakdoshe.

Veod, deamar rav nachman amar rav huna: tana "korbano laAdonai al nizro millevad asher tassig yado", vechi nazir niddon behesseg yad? ha ketzad? "korbano laAdonai al nizro" — shehifrish mishshello, "millevad asher tassig yado" — shehifrishu lo acherim.
Lemay hilcheta? illema leinyan kappara — peshita demikkappar leh! ella leinyan temura, vehachi kaamar: af keshehifrishu lo acherim — ose temura. shema minna: batar mitkapper azlinan!

La leinyan temura, udeka kashya lach mattana deka yahavin leh — i lav derabbi rachamana "millevad asher tassig yado", hava amena gezerat hakkatuv hu "korbano" middideh hu demikkappar, middaacherim la, ka mashma lan.
May have ala? ta shema, deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: makdish mosif chomesh, umitkapper ose temura.
Torem mishshello al shel acherim — tovat hanaa shello. may tama? amar kera: "et kol masar tevuatcha... venatatta vegomer".
Mishna en memirin, lo evarin beubbarin, velo ubbarin beevarim, velo ubbarin veevarim bishlemim, velo shelemim bahen.

Rabbi yose omer: memirin evarim bishlemim, aval lo shelemim bahen. amar rabbi yose: vahalo bemukedashin, haomer "raglah shel zo ola" — kullah ola, af kesheyyomar "raglah shel zo tachat zo" tehe kullah temura tachteha.

Gemara ittemar, bar peda amar: en kedushsha chala al ubbarin, rabbi yochanan amar: kedushsha chala al ubbarin. veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan: hikdish chattat meubberet veyalda — ratza bah mitkapper, ratza bivvladah mitkapper.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan behach kammayyta — hatam hu deakdesheh
b: Leubbara gufeh, aval hacha deakdeshay leimmeh — ha bichlal immeh la kadosh.
Vei ashmeinan batrayyta — hatam hu deakdesh la, vechol deit ba, aval hacha deakdesheh leh — kevan deleteh abbaray, la kadesh. tzericha.
Lishshana acharina, may ka mashma lan? im shiyyeyro — meshuyyayr, veubbar lav yerech immo hu, vetarte lema li?
Tzericha, dei ittemar beha — mishshum deimmeh chazya legufeh, miggo denachata kedushsha la nachata name levalad, aval iddach — la. ka mashma lan hada.
Vei ittemar beha, mishshum deka mefaresh kedushsha al (haem) havvalad, aval hahi la tzericha.

Yatev rabbi zera vekaamar leha shemata, etiveh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: ketzad maarimin al habbechor? hamevakkeret shehayta meubberet, omer: "ma shebbemeeha shel zo ola", yalda zachar — hare zo ola, alma kadosh ubbar!
Amar leh: ki mittanya hahi bikdushshat damim, mi allima kedushshat damim deka mafkea leh min habbechora?

Amar leh: in, vehatnan: kol kadashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu — chayyayvin babbechora uvammattanot. tama dilachar shennifdu dechayyayvin, aval kodem shennifdu — peturin, [alma] deallima kedushshat damim demafka leh mibbechora.
Etiveh: haomer "ma shebbemeeha shel zo ola" — mutteret begizza vaasura baavoda, mishshum kichush ubbar shebbah! amar leh: ha name kedushshat damim.

Umi allima kedushshat damim, deasyra leh baavoda? amar leh: in, vehatnan: yotzin lechullin, liggazez veleaved. tama mishshum denifdu, ha kodem shennifdu asurin baavoda, alma kedushshat damim asvrin leh baavoda.
Etiveh: en memirin lo evarin beubbarin, velo ubbarin beevarin. emure hu dela memar, ha mikdash — kadshi!
Amar leh: bevalde kadashim hu dekaddishi vekayymi.
I velad kadashim, bime imman hu dela avdin, ha abbaray — avdin, veha tanya: en havvalad ose temura!
Ha manni? rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: havvalad ose temura.
I rabbi yehuda, temura hu dela avdi, ha mikdash — kadshi, haamar rabbi yehuda: evarin la kadshi! amar [leh]: hacha bemay askinan — beevar shehanneshama teluya bo.
Etiveh: makdishin evarin veubbarin, aval lo memirin! hacha name bevalde kadashim.
I bevalde kadashim, may "makdishin"? ha kaddishi vekayymi!

a: Hachi kaamar: makdishin evarin umemirin bahen, aval lo memirin bahen, veubbarim shekkadshu bime imman en memirin bahen.
Bevalde kadashim, bime imman — hu dela avdin temura, ha abbaray — avdi. veha tenan: en havvevladot osin temura! ha manni? rabbi yehuda hi.
I rabbi yehuda, evarin mi kadshi? ha lerabbi yehuda let leh haomer "raglah shel zo ola" — kullah ola!
Amar leh: hacha bemay askinan — bedavar haose otah terefa.
Lema ketannae: hashshochet et hachattat, umatza bah ben arba chay, katane chada: enah neechelet ella lezichre chehunna, veenah neechelet ella lifnim min hakkelaim, veenah neechelet ella leyom echad.
Vetanya iddach: neechelet lechol adam, veneechalin bechol makom, veenan neechalin baazara. may lav tannae hi? demar savar: kedushsha chala al ubbarin, umar savar: en kedushsha chala al ubbarin.
La, hane tannae beha ka mippalgi, demar savar: valdot kadashim bahavayaytan hen kedoshim, umar savar: valde kadashim bime imman hen kedoshim.
Veibbaet ema, chad tanna hu, chada mehalen matneyayta — bemakdish behema veachar kach nitabbera, vachada minnehon — shehikdishah meubberet.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: kilayim, uterefa, veyotze dofen, tumetum, veanderoginos — lo kedoshin velo makdishin. veamar shemuel: lo kedoshin bitmura, velo makdishin laasot temura.
Vetanya, amar rabbi meir: meachar sheenan kedoshin, heach makdishin? i atta motze ella bemakdish behema veachar kach nitrefa, bemakdish valad veyatza [derech] dofen. alma kadesh valad!

Amri: betam bime temima, afillu bar peda name mode dekadesh. lo nechleku ella betam bime baalat mum. bar peda savar: kevan deimmeh la mikkaddesha kedushshat hagguf, hu name la kadesh. verabbi yochanan savar: hane kishte vehemot ninhu, immeh hi dela mikkaddesha, aval hu kadosh.
Lishshana acharina, aval kilayim vetumetum veanderoginos, i atta motze ella bevalde kodashim.
Ucherabbi yehuda, shehaya omer: havvalad ose temura. halen hu dela kadshi gufayyhu, aval ubbarin acherim kedoshin!

Amar abbaye: tam bime temima — divre hakkol kadesh gufeh, ella ki peligi bime baalat mum, devar peda savar: kevan deimmeh name la kadesh gufa — ihu name la kadesh ella lidme, rabbi yochanan savar: ubbar lav yerech immo hu, veaf al gav deimmeh la kadsha legufa — valad miha kadesh legufeh.
Amar rabbi yose: vahalo bemukedashin, haomer "raglah shel zo" kulei.
b: Tanu rabbanan: yachol haomer "raglah shel zo ola" tehe kullah ola? talmud lomar: "kol asher yitten mimmennu laAdonai yihye kodesh" — mimmennu laAdonai, velo kullo laAdonai.
Yachol tetze lechullin? talmud lomar "yihye kodesh". ha ketzad? timmacher letzorche olot, vedameha chullin, chutz middeme ever shebbah — divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda.
Verabbi yose verabbi shimon omer: minnayin laomer "raglah shel zo ola", shekkullah ola? shenneemar: "kol asher yitten mimmennu laAdonai", keshehu omer "yihye kodesh" — lerabbot et kullah.
Amar mar: timmacher letzorche olot, veha kamayyte behema mechusseret ever? amar rava: beomer "hare alay ola bechayyeha".
Amar rav chisda: mode rabbi yehuda bedavar sheose otah terefa. rava amar: bedavar sheose otah nevela. verav sheshet amar: bedavar shehi meta.
May ikka ben rav chisda lerava? ikka benayyhu terefa chayya. rav chisda savar la keman deamar terefa enah chayya, verava savar la keman deamar terefa chayya.
Umay ikka ben rava lerav sheshet? ikka benayyhu derabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: nittela yarech vechalal shellah — nevela. rava savar la kerabbi elazar, rav sheshet la savar la kerabbi elazar.
Metivi: amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda bedavar sheen hanneshama teluya bo, vedivre rabbi yose bedavar shehanneshama teluya bo. lav mikkelal diflig aleh derabbi yehuda?

Bishlama nirin divre rabbi yehuda bedavar sheen hanneshama teluya bo, mikkelal diflig aleh derabbi yose. ella nirin divre rabbi yose bedavar shehanneshama teluya bo — lav mikkelal diflig aleh derabbi yehuda? uteyuveta dechullehu!

La, chassore michassera vehachi katane: nirin divre rabbi yose lerabbi yehuda bedavar shehanneshama teluya bo, sheaf rabbi yehuda lo nechlak alav ella bedavar sheen hanneshama teluya bo, aval bedavar shehanneshama teluya bo mode leh.
Bae rava: baof mahu? "behema" amar rachamana, veha lav "behema" hi, o dilma "korban" amar rachamana, vehay name "korban" hu? teku.

Bae rava: hikdish ever ledamav, mahu detechot leh kedushshat hagguf? mi amar: kevan denachata leh kedushshat damim — nachata leh name kedushshat hagguf, umiddeakdesheh lechad ever — akdeshay lechulla, o dilma chad miggo amar, tere miggo la amar?
Tifshot leh middideh, dehaamar rava: hikdish zachar ledamav — kadosh kedushshat hagguf!
Hatam — deakdesheh lechulleh, hacha — deakdesheh chad ever, may? teku.
Bae minneh [abbaye] merava: hikdish chad ever, mahu begizza? tifshot lach meha detanya: "lo tagoz bechor tzoncha", aval atta gozez beshellecha veshel acherim.
Hatam, la nachata leh kedushsha kelal; hacha, nachata leh kedushsha. lishshana acharina: hatam, en beyado lehakedisho; hacha, beyado lehakedisho.
Bea minneh abbaye merava: hikdish orah, mahu baavoda? ta shema: haomer "ma shebbemeeha shel zo ola" — mutteret begizza, vaasura baavoda, mippene kichush ubbar shebbah.
Amar leh: ki katane asura baavoda — midderabbanan. i hachi, afillu begizza name tittesar! amar leh: avoda demaychchasha — gazri ba rabbanan, gizza — la gazri ba rabbanan.
Bea minneh abbaye merav yosef: hi shelamim uveladah chullin, ushechatah bifnim, mahu? leman deamar valde kadashim bahavayaytan hen kedoshin, mi have chullin baazara o la?

a: Amar leh: mi karena beh "ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom... vezavachta"?
Bae minneh abbaye merav yosef: hi chullin uveladah shelamim, ushechatah bechutz — mahu? mi michayyayv aleh mishshum shechute chutz, o la?
Amar leh: mi karena beh "veheviam laAdonai"?
Lishshana acharina, amar leh: rauy lefetach ohel moed chayyayvin alav bachutz.
Mishna en hamedumma medammea, ella lefi cheshbon.
Veen hamechummatz mechammetz ella lefi cheshbon, veen hammayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve ella lefi cheshbon.
Veen me chattat, osin me chattat ella im mattan efer, veen bet happeras osin bet happeras, veen teruma achar teruma.
Veen temura osa temura, velo havvalad ose temura. rabbi yehuda omer: havvalad ose temura. amru lo: hekdesh ose temura, veen havvalad ose temura.
Gemara man tanna? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: dela kerabbi eliezer.
Ditnan: sea shel teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea chullin, venidmeu, venafal min hamedumma lemakom acher, rabbi eliezer omer: medammea kitruma vadday (sheani omer: sea shennafla hi shealta).
Vachachamim omrim: enah medammaat ella lefi cheshbon shebbah.
Veen hamechummatz mechammetz kulei. amar rabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan: matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer.

Ditnan: seor shel chullin veshel teruma shennaflu letoch haissa, velo baze kede lehachemitz, velo baze kede lehachemitz, venitztarfu vechimmetzu. rabbi eliezer omer: achar acharon ani ba, vachachamim omrim: ben shennafal issur lechattechilla uven shennafal issur bassof, leolam en asur ad sheyyehe bo kede lehachemitz.

Veen hammayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve. man tana? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi, ditnan: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: mikve sheyyesh bo esrim veachat sea me geshamim, memalle bakkatef tesha esre sea, ufotkan lammikve,
b: Vehen tehorin, shehashsheiva metaheret birviyyay uvehamshacha.
Mikkelal derabbanan savri devirviyyay uvehamshacha la? ella dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: sheuva shehimshichuha kullah — tehora. manni? la rabbanan vela rabbi eliezer!
Ella amar rabba: lefi cheshbon kelim, veyosef ben choni hi.

Detanya: sheloshet luggin mayim sheuvin shennaflu lammayim, bishnayim ushelosha kelim, vaafillu bearbaa vachamishsha kelim — poslim et hammikve. yosef ben choni omer: bishnayim ushelosha kelim (posel) [poslin] et hammikve, bearbaa vachamishsha — en poslin et hammikve.
Veen me chattat (naase) [naasin] me chattat kulei. man tanna? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: dela kerabbi shimon.
Detanya: hikdim afar lammayim — pasul, verabbi shimon machshir.
May tama derabbi shimon? dichtiv "velakchu lattame meafar serefat hachattat venatan alav mayim chayyim", vetanya: rabbi shimon omer: vechi afar hu? vahalo efer hu!

Shinna hakkatuv mimmashmao, ladun hemennu gezera shava: neemar kan "afar", veneemar lehallan "afar". ma lehallan — afar al gabbe hammayim, af kan — afar al gabbe hammayim. uma kan hikdim afar lammayim — kasher, af kan hikdim afar lammayim — kasher.
Vehacha menalan? tere kerae ketivi: "venatan alav", alma efer beresha, vahadar ketiv "mayim chayyim el keli". ha ketzad? ratza afar lematta, ratza afar lemala.
Vetanna didan, may tama? amar lach: sefeh dikra davka, "venatan alav" — learvan.
May chazet deamrat sefeh dikra davka, dilma resha davka? la matzet amrat, ma matzinu bechol makom machshir lemala, af kan machshir lemala.
Veen bet happeras ose bet happeras kulei. matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer, ditnan: rabbi eliezer omer: bet happeras ose bet happeras.
Verabbanan, ad kamma? ki ata rav dimi amar resh lakish amar rabbi shimon bar abba:

a: Shalosh sadot ushete maanot. vechamma melo maane? mea amma, kidtanya: hachoresh et hakkever — ose bet happeras melo maane mea amma.
Veen teruma achar teruma kulei. matnitin manni? rabbi akiva hi, ditnan: hashshuttafin shettarmu ze achar ze, rabbi eliezer omer: terumat shenehem teruma.
Rabbi akiva omer: en terumat shenehem teruma, vachachamim omrim: im taram harishon kashshiur — en terumat hashsheni teruma, veim lo taram kashshiur — terumat hashsheni teruma.
Veen temura osa temura kulei. may tama? amar kera: "utemurato", velo temurat temurato.
Veen havvalad ose temura. deamar kera: "hu" — hu velo valad.
Rabbi yehuda omer: havvalad ose temura. deamar kera "yihye" lerabbot et havvalad. verabbanan: lerabbot shogeg kemezid.

Mishna haofot vehammenachot en osin temura, shello neemar ella behema. hatztzibbur vehashshuttafin en osin temura, shenneemar "lo yachalifennu velo yamir". yachid ose temura, veen hatztzibbur vehashshuttafin osin temura. kodshe bedek habbayit en osin temura.
Amar rabbi shimon: vahare maaser bakkelal haya, velamma yatza?
Lomar lach: ma maaser — korban yachid, yatzu korbenot tzibbur; uma maaser — korban mizbeach, yatzu korbanot bedek habbayit.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: yachol yehu kodshe bedek habbayit osin temura? talmud lomar "korban" — mi shennikreu "korban", yatzu kodshe bedek habbayit shello nikreu "korban".
Vela? vehatanya: i "korban" — shomea ani afillu kodshe bedek habbayit, shennikreu "korban", kainyan shenneemar: "vannakrev et korban Adonai vegomer".

Talmud lomar "veel petach ohel moed lo hevio" — kol habba el petach ohel moed chayyayvin alav mishshum shechute chutz, vechol sheeno ba lefetach ohel moed en chayyayvin alav mishshum shechute chutz. alma ikkeru "korban".
Amar rabbi chanina: la kashya, ha rabbi shimon, ha rabbanan. lerabbi shimon ikkeri "korban", lerabbanan la ikkeri "korban".
Vela? vehachtiv: "vannakrev et korban Adonai"! "korban Adonai" ikkeri, "korban laAdonai" la ikkeri.
Tanu rabbanan: "lo yevakker ben tov lara velo yemirennu", lamma neemar? vahalo kevar neemar "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov beravgo".
Lefi shenneemar "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto", mashma korban yachid, korban tzibbur, vekorban mizbeach vekorban bedek habbayit, talmud lomar "lo yevakker".

Amar rabbi shimon: vahare maaser bakkelal haya, velamma yatza? lomar lach: ma maaser korban yachid, vekorban mizbeach, vedavar shebba bechova, vedavar sheeno beshuttafut — af kol korban yachid, vekorban mizbeach, vedavar shebba bechova,
b: Vedavar sheeno ba beshuttafut.
Rabbi omer: lamma yatza maaser meatta? liddon bitmurat shemo" uvitmurat gufo".
Lomar lach: temurat shemo — kereva, temurat gufo — enah kereva; temurat shemo — nigelet, temurat gufo — enah nigelet.
Temurat gufo — chala al davar harauy veal davar sheeno rauy, utemurat shemo — enah chala ella al davar harauy bilvad.
Amri: mishshum derabbi rachamana deit beh temurat shemo, iggeroe iggera? in, deamrinan: may derabbi — rabbi, umay dela rabbi — la rabbi.
Veha mehecha tete? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: mishshum dehave davar habba liddon bedavar hechadash, veen bo ella chiddusho bilvad.
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: lerabbi shimon deamar davar habba bechova — olat chova hi deavda temura, ha olat nedava — la? amar leh: olat nedava name, kevan dekabbela aleh — avda temura.
Velo nitzrecha, ella leola habbaa min hammotarot.
May kasavar? i kasavar la keman deamar motarot lenidvat tzibbur azli — peshita dela avda temura, ha en temura betzibbur!

Ella, rabbi shimon sevira leh keman deamar motarot lenidvat yachid azli. man shamat leh hay sevara? rabbi eliezer! ha shaminan leh behedya deavda temura, detanya: "ola habbaa min hammotarot osa temura", divre rabbi eliezer!
Rabbi shimon savar la kevateh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada, derabbi eliezer savar: ola habbaa min hammotarot osa temura, veihu savar: en osa temura.
I hachi, devae rabbi avin: hifrish asham lehitkapper bo, vehemir bo, venitkapper beasham acher, venittak ze leola — mahu sheyyachzor veyamir bo?
Allibba deman? ilema allibba derabbi shimon — ha amrat rabbi shimon sevira leh: ola habbaa min hammotarot en osa temura!

Rabbi avin hachi kamibbaya leh: i mashkachat tanna dekae kerabbi shimon, deamar en memirin vechozrin umemirin, usevira leh kerabbi eliezer, deamar ola habbaa min hammotarot osa temura, mahu sheyyachzor veyamir bo?
Bishne gufin ukedushsha achat, may?
Veim timtza lomar: kedushsha achat (o la), ella shete kedushshot veguf echad, may? tibbee.
Hadaran alach hakkol memirin.

a: Mishna yesh bekorbenot yachid sheen bekorbenot hatztzibbur, veyesh bekorbenot hatztzibbur sheen bekorbenot hayyachid, shekkorbenot hayyachid osin temura, veen korbenot hatztzibbur osin temura.

Korbenot hayyachid nohagot ben bizcharim ben binkevot, vekorbenot hatztzibbur en nohagin ella bizcharim. korbenot hayyachid chayyayvin beachrayutan uveachrayut niskehem, vekorbenot hatztzibbur en chayyayvin beachrayutan velo beachrayut niskehen, aval chayyayvin beachrayut niskehen mishshekkarav hazzevach.
Yesh bekorbenot hatztzibbur ma sheen bekorbenot yachid, shekkorbenot hatztzibbur dochin et hashshabbat veet hattumea, vekorbenot yachid enan dochot lo et hashshabbat velo et hattumea.
Amar rabbi meir: vahalo chavitte kohen gadol, ufar shel yom hakkippurim, korbenot hayyachid hen, vedochin et hashshabbat veet hattumea! ella shezzemanno kavua.
Gemara korban yachid ose temura kulei. uchelala hu? vahare ofot dekorban yachid, veen ose temura! ki katane — bivhema katane.
Vahare valad dekarban yachid hu, veen ose temura! ha manni? rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: havvalad ose temura.
Vahare temura atzmah, dekorban yachid hi, veen temura osa temura! ki katane — beikkar zivcha katane.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, afillu tema rabbanan, beikkar zivcha katane.
Korbenot hayyachid nohagot ben bizcharim ben binkevot. uchelala hu? vahare ola, dekorban yachid, vezachar atya, nekeva la atya!
Haikka olat haof, detanya: tammut vezachrut bivhema, veen tammut vezachrut baofot.
Vahare chattat, dekorban yachid hi, unekeva atya, zachar la atya? haikka seir nasi, demayyte zachar.

Vehaikka asham yachid, dezachar ate, nekeva la ate? ki kaamri rabbanan korban deshave ben beyachid ben betzibbur — asham beyachid iteh, betzibbur leteh. veibbaet ema: mi katane "kol korbenot"? "yesh bekorbenot" katane, umay nihu — shelamim, vei bae nekeva mayyte, vei bae zachar mayyte.
Korbenot yachid chayyayvin beachrayutan [kulei]. mena lan?
Detanu rabbanan: "devar yom" — melammed shekkol hayyom kasher lemusafin, "beyomo" — melammed sheim avar hayyom velo hevian eno chayyayv beachrayutan.
Yachol lo yehe chayyayv beachrayut niskehem, veaf al pi shekkarav hazzevach? talmud lomar "minchatam veniskehem" ballayla, "minchatam veniskehem" lemachar.
Resh lakish amar mehacha: "millevad shabbatot Adonai".

Utzericha, dei ketav rachamana "millevad shabbetot Adonai" — hava amena: bayyom — in, uvallayla — la. amar kera "uminchatam veniskehem". vei ketav rachamana "minchatam veniskehem" vela ketav "millevad shabbetot Adonai" — hava amena: (ballayla) [belelya] — in, bimama — la.
Umay shena? mishshum divkadashim layla holech achar hayyom, tzerichi.
Unesachim mi karvi ballayla? vehatnan: en li ella devarim sheddarkan likrav ballayla, kegon evarim ufedarim, shemmakrivin mibbo hashshemesh umitakkelin veholchin kol hallayla kullo.

Devarim sheddarkan likrav bayyom, kegon hakkometz, hallevona, uminchat nesachim, shemmaalan mibbo hashshemesh. mibbo hashshemesh salka datach?! vehaamrat devarim sheddarkan likrav bayyom ninhu! ella im bo hashshemesh, shemmitakkelin veholchin kol hallayla minnayin? talmud lomar: "zot torat haola" — ribba.
Katane miha nesachim bayyom! amar rame bar chama: la kashya — kan likdash, kan likrav.

Amar leh rava: i mikdash kadshi karove mikkarvi, veha tanya: ze hakkelal: kol hakkarev bayyom — en kadosh ella bayyom, vechol hakkarev ballayla — kadosh ballayla, ben bayyom ben belayla — kadosh ben bayyom ben ballayla! ella amar rav yosef: semi "minchat nesachim" meha matnita.

Ki selek rav dimi, ashkecheh lerav yirmeya deyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: minnayin linsachim habbaim im hazzevach sheen kerevin ella bayyom? talmud lomar "uleniskechem uleshalmechem" — ma shelamim bayyom, af nesachim bayyom.
Amar: i ashkecheh dechatev iggarta, shelachi leh lerav yosef,
b: Vela tisme "minchat nesachim" mimmatnita. vela kashya — kan binsachim habbain im hazzevach, kan binsachim habbain bifne atzman.
Vei hava leh iggarta, mi efshar lemishlecha? veha amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: kotve halachot (kesoref) [kesorfe] tora, vehallamed mehen eno notel sachar.

Daresh rabbi yehuda bar nachmani meturegmaneh deresh lakish: katuv echad omer "ketov lecha et haddevarim haelle", vechatuv echad omer "ki al pi haddevarim haelle" — lomar lach: devarim sheal pe i atta rashshay leomran bichtav, veshebbichtav i atta rashshay leomran al pe.
Vetana deve rabbi yishmael: "ketov lecha et haddevarim haelle" — elle atta kotev, aval en atta kotev halachot!

Amri: dilma milleta chadta shane, deha rabbi yochanan veresh lakish meayyeyni besifra deaggadta beshabbeta, vedarshi hachi: "et laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha", amri: mutav teaker tora, veal tishtakkach tora miyyisrael.
Amar rav pappa: hasheta deamrat nesachim habbain bifne atzman kerevin afillu ballayla, nizdammenu nesachim ballayla — makdishin ballayla umakrivin.
Amar leh rav yosef bereh derav shemaya lerav pappa: tanya dimsayyay lach, "ze hakkelal: kol hakkarev bayyom — eno kadosh ella bayyom, vechol hakkarev ballayla — kadosh ben bayyom ben ballayla".
Amar rav adda bar ahava: vaalot hashshachar poselet bahen, keevarin.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: "elle taasu laAdonai bemoadechem" — ellu chovot habbaot chova baregel.
"Levad minnidrechem venidvotechem" — limmed al nedarim unedavot shekkerevin bechullo shel moed.
"Uleolotechem" — bema hakkatuv medabber? i beolat neder — hare kevar amur "nidrechem", vei beolat nedava — hare kevar amur "venidvotechem"! ha eno medabber ella beolat yoledet veolat metzora.
"Uleminchotechem" — bema hakkatuv medabber? i beminchat neder — hare kevar amur, i beminchat nedava — hare kevar amur! ha eno medabber ella beminchat sota uveminchat kenaot.
"Uleniskechem uleshalmechem" — makkish nesachim lishlamim: ma shelamim bayyom, af nesachim bayyom. "uleshalmechem" — lerabbot shalme nazir.
Amar leh abbaye: velema mar shalme fesach, dei shalme nazir — niddar veniddav hu.
Dehatanya ze hakkelal: kol shehu niddav veniddar — karev bevamat yachid, vesheeno niddav veniddar — eno karev bevamat yachid.
Utenan: hammenachot vehannezirot kerevin bevamat yachid, divre rabbi meir! semi mikkan "nezirot".
