Mi ikka leman deamar denazir lav niddar veniddav hu? vehachtiv: "mikketz arbaim shana vayyomer avshalom el hammelech elcha na vaashallem et nidri asher nadarti laAdonai bechevron ki neder nadar avdecha vegomer", may lav akkorban?
La, aikkar nidro amri. ikkar nidro bechevron hava? vahalo bigshur hava!
Amar rav acha, veittema rabba bar rav chanan: lo halach avshalom ella lehavi kevasim mechevron. hachi name mistabbera, dei tema leakrove hu deazel — shavek yerushalayim veazel umakrev bechevron?
Veella may? lehavi kevasim mechevron? hay "asher nadarti laAdonai bechevron", "mechevron" mibbee leh!
Ella leolam leakrove, udeka kashya lach: ammay shavek yerushalayim umakrev bechevron? tikshe lach givon, demakom kadosh hu! ella, kevan shehutteru habbamot — kol hecha devae makrev.

Arbaim shana, leman? tanya: rabbi nehoray omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua: "mikketz arbaim shana" sheshshaalu lahem melech, detanya: otah shana sheshshaalu lahem melech, otah shana asirit shel shemuel hayta.

a: Eser shanim malach shemuel beatzmo, shana achat shemmalach shaul ushemuel, ushetayim shemmalach shaul beatzmo, usheloshim vasheva shemmalach david.
Mishna chattat hayyachid shekkipperu bealeha — meta, veshel tzibbur — enah meta.

Rabbi yehuda omer: tamut. rabbi shimon omer: ma matzinu bivlad chattat, uvitmurat chattat, uvechattat shemmetu bealeha — devarim amurim beyachid velo betzibbur, af shekkipperu bealeha veibbera shenatah — beyachid devarim amurim velo betzibbur.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: mahu omer chattat "yavi"? minnayin lemakdish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, venimtzet harishona kayyemet, vahare shetehen omdot — minnayin sheezo mehen sheyyirtze yavi? talmud lomar "chattat". yachol yavi shetehen? talmud lomar "yevienna" — achat velo shetayim.
Veotah sheniyya ma tehe aleha? amar rav hamenuna, tanya: rabbi yehuda omer: tire, rabbi shimon omer: tamut.

Umi amar rabbi yehuda tire? veha rabbi yehuda "tamut" shaminan leh! efoch: rabbi yehuda omer: tamut, rabbi shimon omer: tire. umi amar rabbi shimon tire? veha amar rabbi shimon: chamesh chattaot metot!
Ella (amar leh) leolam la tefoch, vela kashya: kan — baavuda bishat haferasha, kan — baavuda bishat kappara.
Veibbaet ema: idde veidde bishat haferasha, vela kashya — ha rabbi yehuda allibba derabbi, ha rabbi yehuda allibba derabbanan.
Umi ikka leman deamar chattat tzibbur shekkipperu bealim meta?
b: Vehatanya: kayyotze bo amar rabbi yose: "vehabbaim mehashshevi vene haggola hikrivu olot... parim bene vakar shenem asar... elim tishim vetisha, kevasim shivim veshiva, seire chattat shenem asar — hakkol ola laAdonai".

Vechattat mi karva ola? amar rava: ki ola, ma ola enah neechelet — af chattat enah neechelet, shehaya rabbi yose omer: al avoda zara hevium, veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: al avoda zara sheasu bime tzidkiyyahu.
Ka salka datin, leman deit leh chattat tzibbur shennitkapperu bealeha — meta, it leh name chattat tzibbur shemmetu bealeha — meta, veha hacha deikka demetu baaleh, veka karva!
Amar rav pappa: afillu leman deamar chattat tzibbur shekkipperu bealeha meta, chattat tzibbur shemmetu bealeha enah meta, lefi sheen hatztzibbur metim.
Mena leh lerav pappa ha? i nema mishshum dichtiv "tachat avotecha yihyu vanecha", i hachi, afillu yachid name!

Ella hayeynu tama, sheen hatztzibbur metim, misseire regalim verashe chodashim, deamar rachamana: ayytinhu mitterumat hallishka. vedilma mitu marayyhu dehane zuze? ella lav shema minna en hatztzibbur metim.

Veibbaet ema: ki akruvinhu lehane chattaot — achayye akruvinhu, dichtiv: "verabbim mehakkohanim haleviyyim verashe haavot hazzekenim asher rau et habbayit harishon beyosdo ze habbayit... bochim bekol gadol verabbim bitrua".
Vedilma hanach miuta? la matzet amrat, dichtiv "velo hikkiru haam batterua vesimcha lekol bechi haam".
Vehechi makrevi lehu? vahare mezidin havo! amar rabbi yochanan: horaat shaa hayta.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei la tema hachi — bishlama parim useirim keneged shenem asar shevatim, ella kevasim keneged mi? ella horaat shaa hayta.
Tenan hatam: mishshemmet yosef ben yoezer ish tzereda veyosef ben yochanan ish yerushalayim, batlu haeshkolot. ish shehakkol bo.

Veamar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: kol eshkolot sheamdu lahen leyisrael mimot moshe ad shemmet yosef ben yoezer — hayu lemedin tora kemoshe rabbenu, mikkan veelach — lo hayu lemedin tora kemoshe rabbenu.
Vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: sheloshet alafim halachot nishtakkechu bime evlo shel moshe! deishtechuch lehu — ishtechuch, vedigmiran lehu — havo gemiri kemoshe rabbenu.
Veha tanya: mishshemmet moshe, im rabbu metammein — timmeu, im rabbu tehorin — tiheru!
Libba deimmeit, migmar havo gemiri lehu kemoshe rabbenu.
Bematnita tana: kol eshkolot sheamdu leyisrael mimot moshe ad shemmet yosef ben yoezer ish tzereda — lo haya bahem shum dofi, mikkan veelach — haya bahen shum dofi.

Vehatanya: maase bechasid echad shehaya goneach millibbo, veshaalu larofim, veamru: en lo takkana ad sheyyinak chalav roteach shacharit, veheviu ez vekashru lo bechare mittato, vehaya yonek mimmenna chelev.
Lemachar nichnesu chaverav levakkero, kevan sherau haez amru: listim mezuyyayn betoch beto, veanu nichnasim levakkero?! yashvu uvadku, velo matzu bo avon ella shel otah haez bilvad.
Veaf hu bishat mitato amar: yodea ani beatzmi sheen bi avon, ella shel otah haez bilvad, sheavarti al divre chaveray, shehare amru chachamim: en megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael.
Vekayyma lan, kol hecha deamar "maase bechasid echad" — o rabbi yehuda ben bava o rabbi yehuda bar ilay, verabbanan batar yosef ben yoezer ish tzereda dare dare havo.

a: Amar rav yosef: dofi shel semicha katane.
Veha yosef ben yoezer gufeh miflayg pelig bismicha! ki ippelig ba besof sheneh, divtzar libba.
Gufa, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: sheloshet alafim halachot nishtakkechu bime evlo shel moshe. amru lo lihoshua: sheal! amar lahem: "lo vashshamayim hi".
Amru lo lishmuel: sheal! amar lahem: "elle hammitzvot" — sheen hannavi rashshay lechaddesh davar meatta. amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: af chattat shemmetu bealeha nishtakkecha bime evlo shel moshe.
Amru lefinchas: sheal! amar lahem: "lo vashshamayim hi". amru lo leelazar: sheal! amar lahem: "elle hammitzvot", sheen navi rashshay lechaddesh davar meatta.

Amar rav yehuda, amar rav: beshaa shenniftar moshe rabbenu legan eden, amar lo lihoshua: sheal mimmenni kol sefekot sheyyesh lach. amar lo: rabbi, kelum hinnachticha shaa achat vehalachti lemakom acher? lo kach katavta bi "umesharto yehoshua bin nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel"? miyyad tashash kocho shel yehoshua, venishtakkechu mimmennu shelosh meot halachot, venoldu lo sheva meot sefekot, veamdu kol yisrael lehorgo.
Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: lomar lach i efshar, lech vetorden bemilchama, shenneemar: "vayhi achare mot moshe eved Adonai vayyomer Adonai vegomer".
Bematnitin tana: elef usheva meot kallin vachamurin, ugezerot shavot, vedikidduke sofrim nishtakkechu bime evlo shel moshe.

Amar rabbi avahu: af al pi chen hechziran otniel ben kenaz mittoch pilpulo, shenneemar: "vayyilkedah otniel ben kenaz achi chalev vayyitten lo et achsa vitto leishsha". velamma nikra shemah "achsa"? shekkol haroe otah koes al ishto.

Vayhi bevoa vattesitehu lishol meet aviha sade vattitznach meal hachamor, may "vattitznach"? amar rava amar rabbi yitzchak: amra lo, ma chamor ze, kevan sheen lo maachol baavuso — miyyad tzoek, kach ishsha, kevan sheen lah tevua betoch betah — miyyad tzoeket.

Vattomer tena li veracha ki eretz hannegev netattani, bayit shemmenuggav mikkol tova, "venatatta li gullot mayim" — adam sheen bo ella tora bilvad. "vayyitten lah kalev et gullot illiyyot veet gullot tachtiyyot" — amar lah: mi sheddar elyonim vetachtonim yevakkesh mimmennu mezonot?!
Vechalev ben kenaz hu? vahalo "kalev ben yefunne" hu! may "yefunne"? sheppana meatzat meraggelim.
Veakkatti ben kenaz hu? ben chetzron hu, dichtiv: "vechalev ben chetzron holid et azuva". amar rava: chorgeh diknaz hu.
Tanna: hu otniel, hu yabetz, uma shemo? yehuda achi shimon shemo. "otniel" — sheanao el, "yabetz" — sheyyaatz veribbetz tora beyisrael.
Umenalan sheanao el? dichtiv: "vayyikra yabetz lelohe yisrael lemor im barech tevarcheni vehirbita et gevuli vehayta yadcha immadi vaase meraati levilti otzbi vayyave elohim et asher shaal".

Im berach tevarcheni — battora, "vehirbita et gevuli" — betalmidim, "vehayta yadcha immadi" — shello yishtakkeach talmudi millibbi, "vaase meraati" — sheyyizdammenu li reim kemoti, "levilti otzbi" — shello yesaggeveni yetzer hara millishnot. im atta ose ken — mutav, veim lav — hareni holech (linsisi) [binsisi] lashsheol. miyyad, "vayyave elohim et asher shaal".

Keyotze baddavar atta omer: "rash veish techachim nifgashu meir ene shenehem Adonai". beshaa shehattalmid holech etzel rabbo veomer lo: "lammedeni tora", im melammedo — "meir ene shenehem Adonai", veim lav — "ashir varash nifgashu ose chullam Adonai". mi sheasao chacham laze — ose oto tippesh, tippesh laze — ose oto chacham. zo mishnat rabbi natan.

Rabbi yehuda hannasi omer: "im barech tevarcheni" — bifriyya ureviyya, "vehirbita et gevuli" — bevanim uvevanot, "vehayta yadcha immadi" — bemassa uvemattan, "veasita meraati" — shello yehe bi mechosh rosh umechosh oznayim umechosh enayim, "levilti otzbi" — shello yesaggeveni yetzer hara millishnot. im atta ose ken — mutav, veim lav — hareni holech binsisi lashsheol, "vayyave lo elohim et asher shaal".

Keyotze baddavar atta omer: "rash veish techachim nifgashu meir ene shenehem Adonai", beshaa sheani holech etzel baal habbayit veamar: parneseni, im mefarneso — mutav, veim lav — "ashir varash nifgashu ose chullam Adonai", mi sheasao ashir laze — ose oto ani, ani laze — ose oto ashir.
Amar rabbi shimon: ma matzinu kulei.
Tanu rabbanan: rabbi shimon omer: chamesh chattaot metot, velad chattat, utemurat chattat, vechattat shemmetu bealeha, vechattat shekkipperu bealeha, vechattat sheibbera shenatah.

I atta yachol lomar velad chattat betzibbur — lefi sheen chattat nekeva betzibbur, vei atta yachol lomar temurat chattat betzibbur — lefi sheen tzibbur osin temura, vei atta yachol lomar chattat shemmetu bealeha betzibbur — lefi sheen hatztzibbur metim.
Shekkipperu bealeha, vesheibbera shenatah — lo matzinu. yachol yehu nohagot ben beyachid ben betzibbur?
Amarta: yilmad adam satum mimmeforash, ma meforash beyachid velo betzibbur, af beshekkipperu bealeha vesheibbera shenatah beyachid devarim amurim velo betzibbur.
b: Vechi danin efshar mishshei efshar? rabbi shimon bechad makom gemir lehu.
Amar resh lakish: arbaa nittenu lahen, veheemidum al chamesh. vei salka datach betzibbur — hanach mi itanhu betzibbur? ella al korchaych — yilmad satum mimmeforash.
Rabbi natan omer: achat nittena lahen, veheemiduha al chamesh.
Velichze behe sidra gemiri lehu, i beyachid i betzibbur?
Shete shichchayot shachchu, vekashya lehu.
Vei salka datach betzibbur, hanach mi itanhu betzibbur? ella shema minna: yilmad satum mimmeforash — ma meforash beyachid velo betzibbur, af satum beyachid velo betzibbur.

Mishna chomer bakkodashim mibbattemura, vechomer battemura mibbakkodashim. chomer bekadashim mibbattemura — shehakkodashim osin temura, veen temura osa temura. hatztzibbur vehashshuttafin makdishin, aval lo memirin. umakdishin ubbarin veevarim, aval lo memirin.
Chomer battemura mibbakkodashim, shehakkedushsha chala al baalat mum kavua, veen yotza lechullin

a: Liggazez veleaved. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: asa shogeg kemezid battemura, velo asa shogeg kemezid bammukedashin.
Rabbi elazar omer: hakkilayim, vehatterefa, vehayyotze dofen, vetumetum, veanderoginos — lo kedoshin, velo makdishin.
Gemara may tama derabbi yose berabbi yehuda? amar kera "yihye kodesh", lerabbot shogeg kemezid.
Hechi dame shogeg kemezid? amar chizkiyya: kesavur shehu muttar lehamir. gabbe temura — lake, gabbe kadashim — la lake.
Lishshana acharina: gabbe temura — kadesh, gabbe kadashim — la kadesh.
Resh lakish verabbi yochanan amri: kesavur lomar "temurat ola", veamar "temurat shelamim". lishshana acharina: gabbe temurat shelamim — kadesh, gabbe kadashim — la kadesh.
Lishshana achrina, kesavur lomar "shachor" veamar "lavan" — gabbe temura lake, gabbe kadashim la lake.
Rabbi yochanan amar: beomer "tetze zo vetikkanes zo". gabbe kadashim, beomer shennolad bahem mum neechalin belo pidyon — la lake, gabbe temura — lake.
Rav sheshet amar: beomer "ekkanes labbayit ze veakdish" veamir middati, venichnas vehemir vehikdish shello middato — gabbe temura lake, gabbe kadashim la lake.
Rabbi elazar omer: hakkilayim vehatterefa vechulei. amar shemuel: lo kedoshin bitmura, velo makdishin laasot temura.

Tanya, amar rabbi meir: umeachar sheen kedoshin, mehechan makdishin? ella i atta motze ella bemakdish behema veachar kach nitrefa, bemakdish valad veyatza [derech] dofen. aval kilayim vetumetum veanderoginos, i atta motze ella bevalde kadashim, veallibba derabbi yehuda deamar: havvalad ose temura.
Amar rav pappa: may tama derabbi elazar? kivhema temea — ma behema temea la karva vela nachata la kedushshat hagguf, af hanach la karvi vela nachata lehu kedushshat hagguf.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: vahare baal mum, dela karev, venachata leh kedushshat hagguf! amar leh: baal mum karev bemino. i hachi, terefa name ka karva beminah!
Ella amar rava: kivhema temea, ma behema temea pesul hagguf, af kol pesul hagguf, leappoke baal mum difsul chissaron ninhu.
Amar leh rav adda lerava: vahalo "sarua" vekalut" ketiv bapparasha, veha hane pesul hagguf ninhu!
Ella amar rava: kivhema [temea], ma behema temea delekka bemina, af kol delekka bemina, leappoke baal mum deha ikka bemina.
May amrat: terefa ikka bemina? la damya levaal mum, behema temea asura baachila, uterefa asura baachila, leappoke baal mum demuttar baachila.
Amar shemuel: hammakdish et hatterefa tzericha mum kavua lifdot alav, shema minna podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim?

Ella ema: osa kedushsha (lemita, kesavur muttar lehakedish baale mumin legabbe mizbeach, gabbe temura — kadesh, gabbe kadashim — la kadesh) lamut, verabbi oshaya omer: enah ella kemakdish etzim vaavanim bilvad.

Tenan: kol hakkodashim shennaasu terefa, en podin otan, lefi sheen podin hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim. tama shennaasu, ha hayu meikkara — podin otan! dilma hay tanna savar: kol hecha dela chaze legufa, la nachata la kedushshat hagguf.
Ta shema: rabbi elazar omer: hakkilayim, veyotze dofen, uterefa, vetumetum veanderoginos — lo kedoshin velo makdishin. veamar shemuel: lo kedoshin bitmura, velo makdishin laasot temura.
Vetanya, amar rabbi meir: vechi meachar sheen kedoshin, mehechan makdishin? ella i atta motze ella bemakdish behema veachar kach nitrefa, ha hayta terefa meikkara — la nachata leh kedushshat hagguf.
b: Amar lecha shemuel: dilma hach tanna name savar kol hecha dela chazya legufa — la nachata la kedushshat hagguf.
Hadaran alach yesh bekorbenot.

Mishna ellu kadashim shevvavldotehen utemurotehen kayyotze bahen, velad shelamim utemuratan, veladan uvelad veladan ad sof kol haolam — hare hen shelamim, uteunin semicha unesachim utenufat chaze vashok.

Gemara kevan ditna "veladan uvelad veladan", "ad sof kol haolam" lema li? tanna didan shameh lerabbi elazar deamar "velad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim", vaamar leh tanna didan: la mibbaya bivvladan dela modena, ella afillu ad sof haolam la modena lach.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "zachar" — lerabbot et havvalad.
Vahalo din hu: uma temura, sheen giddule hekdesh — kereva, valad, sheggiddule hekdesh — eno din sheyyikrav?

Ma litmura, shekken noheget bechol hakkodashim, tomar bevalad, sheeno noheg bechol hakkodashim? eno karev hoil veeno noheg bechol hakkodashim. talmud lomar "zachar" — lerabbot et havvalad, "nekeva" — lerabbot hattemura.
En li ella temurat temimin, uvelad temimin, velad baale mumin utemurat baale mumin minnayin? talmud lomar "im zachar" lerabbot velad baale mumin, "im nekeva" lerabbot temurat baale mumin.
Amar leh rav safra leabbaye: veefoch ana! mistabbera, mimmakom shennitrabbeta temurat temimin nitrabbeta temurat baale mumin.

Amar leh: mi kaamena lach lefoch "im zachar" "im nekeva"? ana kulleh kera kaamena! ema: "zachar" lerabbot et hattemura, "nekeva" lerabbot et havvalad. amar leh: "valad" leshon zachar mashma, "temura" leshon nekeva mashma.
Lemay hilcheta? amar shemuel: likrav, veallibba derabbi elazar.
Demahu detema: ki kaamar rabbi elazar ola, deikka shem ola al immo, aval hane veladot la karvi — kamashma lan.
Bar peda amar: liriyya, veallibba dedivre hakkol. deittemar: rava amar: likrav, veallibba derabbi elazar. rav pappa amar: liriyya, veallibba dedivre hakkol.
Vehay tanna mayyte la mehacha.
"Rak kodashecha" — ellu temurot, "asher yihyu lach" — ellu havvevladot, "tissa uvat".

Yachol yachnisennu levet habbechira, veyimna mehem mayim umazon kede sheyyamutu? talmud lomar: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam", kederech sheatta noheg beola — atta noheg bitmura, kederech sheatta noheg bishlamim — atta noheg bevavlde shelamim uvitmura.
Yachol kol kadashim ken? talmud lomar "rak" — divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "asham hu ashom asham laAdonai" — hu karev, veen temurato kereva.
Amar mar: "tissa uvat", yachol yachnisennu levet habbechira?
Mena tete ha? kevan degamri chamesh chattaot, hanach mikrav karvi!
Mahu detema: chamesh chattaot metot bechol makom, vehanach yamutu bevet habbechira — kamashma lan.
Amar mar: yachol af kol hakkodashim ken? talmud lomar "rak kadashecha". valad deman? i deola — zachar hu, velav bar olode hu! vei dechattat — gemiri la dilmita kayymi!

a: I deasham — gemiri la deliriyyay azla, dechol shebbachattat meta baasham roe. leolam bechattat, vehilcheta gemiri la lemita, ukera lemaote lehakerava.
Veha beha talya, kevan dilmita azla — mimmela la karva! ella hilcheta lechattat, vekara lemaote temurat asham.
Ha name hilcheta gemiri la, deamri: kol shebbachattat meta, baasham roe. ella kera mibbee leh, dei avar umakrev — kae baase.
Rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich kulei. hu karev veen temurato kereva. lema li kera, veha hilcheta gemiri lah!
In hachi name, ella kera lema li? mibbee leh lechidrav huna, deamar rav huna: asham shennittak liriyyay ushechato setam — kasher leshem ola.
Nittak — in, lo nittak — la. may tama? hu — bahavavyayto yehe.
Ulehay tanna deka yalef mehane kerae, tippok li mizzachar" unekeva"? hahu mibbee leh livlad baale mumin, velitmurat baale mumin.
Vetippok li kullehu mehay kera? "im" la mashma leh.
Ulehay tanna denafka leh mizzachar" "im nekeva", tissa uvata ma aved lehu! afillu mimmirayyhu. lishshana achrina: mimmoriggayyhu.
Mishna rabbi eliezer omer: velad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim, vachachamim omrim: yikrav.
Amar rabbi shimon: lo nechleku al velad velad shelamim, veal velad velad temura shello yikrav. al ma nechleku? al havvalad, rabbi eliezer omer: lo yikrav, vachachamim omrim: yikrav.

Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi pappeyays al velad shelamim sheyyikrav shelamim. amar rabbi pappeyays: ani meid shehayta lanu para shel zivche shelamim, vaachalnuha bappesach, veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag.
Gemara amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi eliezer? amar kera "veim zevach shelamim korbano laAdonai", veem — velo valad.

Amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi amme: ella meatta, "im al toda yakrivennu", hachi name deem velo valad? vechi tema hachi name, vehatanya: veladah, utemuratah, vechillufeha — minnayin? talmud lomar "im al toda" — mikkol makom.
Ella amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: hayeynu tama derabbi eliezer, gezera shemma yegaddel mehem adarim adarim.
Amar rabbi shimon: lo nechleku kulei.
Ibbaya lehu: hechi tane? "lo nechleku shello yikrevu, ella yikrevu", o dilma: "lo nechleku sheyyikrevu, ella lo yikrevu"?
Amar rabba: mistabbera "lo nechleku shello yikrevu, ella yikrevu". may tama? ad kan la pelig rabbi eliezer aleh derabbanan ella bevalad, aval velad valad — akray bealma hu.

Verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: "lo nechleku sheyyikrevu, ella lo yikrevu". may tama? ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ella bevalad, aval velad valad — mittoch (maaseha) [maasav] nikkeret machshavto dilgaddel ka vae leh.
b: Tane rabbi chiyyay lesayyoe lerabbi yehoshua ben levi: "im kesev hu makriv" — valad rishon karev, valad sheni eno karev.
Hu — karev, veen velad kol hakkodashim karev.
Valad demay? i deola veasham — zecharim hem, vela bene valad hem. i dechattat — hilcheta gemiri la dilmita azla.
Amar ravina: leetoye velad hameusseret, velad hameusseret lema li kera? "avara" "avara" mibbechor ka gamar la!
Itzterich, salka datach amina: en danin efshar mishshei efshar, ka mashma lan.
Heid rabbi shimon verabbi pappeyays kulei.
Ulerava deamar: kadashim, kevan sheavar alehem regel echad, kol yom vayom over alehem beval teacher", meatzeret bae mechleh! amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: kegon shehaya chole baatzeret.
Rav ashe amar: may "chag" name dekatane? — chag shavuot. veiddach, kol hechi dekatane "pesach" tane "atzeret".
I hachi, may ashaduteh? leappoke midderabbi eliezer, deamar "velad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim", kamashed hu dekarev.
Mishna velad toda utemuratah, veladan velad veladan ad sof kol haddorot — hare ellu ketoda, uvilvad sheen teunin lechem.
Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: mahu omer "yakrivennu"?
Mafrish toda, veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, venimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen omdot. minnayin sheezo sheyyirtze yakriv velachmah immah? talmud lomar: "toda yakriv".

Yachol tehe sheniyya teuna lechem? talmud lomar "yakrivennu" — achat velo shetayim. minnayin lerabbot veladot temurot vachalifot? talmud lomar "veim al toda". yachol yehu kullan teunot lechem? talmud lomar "al zevach hattoda" — toda teuna lechem, velo veladah utemuratah vachalifatah teuna lechem.

Mishna temurat ola, velad temura, velad velad veladah ad sof kol haolam — hare ellu keola, uteunin hefshet venittuach vechalil laishshim. hammafrish nekeva leola veyalda zachar — yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher, veyavi bedamav ola. rabbi elazar omer: hu atzmo yikrav ola.
Gemara may shena resha dela peligi, umay shena sefa difligi?

Amar rabba bar bar channa: bemachloket shenuya, verabbi elazar hi. verava amar: afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la feligi aleh derabbi elazar ella gabbe mafrish nekeva leola, deimmeh la kereva, aval temura deimmeh name kereva — afillu rabbanan modu.
Umi amar rabbi elazar yikrav ola hu atzmo? ureminhu: temurat asham, velad temura, veladan, velad veladan ad sof kol haolam — yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyippelu demehen lindava.
Rabbi eliezer omer: yamutu. rabbi elazar omer: yavi bidmehen ola. baddamim — in, hu atzmo — la.

Amar rav chisda: rabbi elazar ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu, ledidi sevira li daafillu valad name karev ola, ledidchu deamritu roe — odo li mihat demotarot lenidvat yachid azli, veamri leh: motarot lenidvat tzibbur azli.
Rava amar: ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar hu atzmo yikrav ola, ella bemafrish nekeva leola, deikka shem ola al immo,
